jobs.title: Associate Director Operational Excellence
jobs.description:
Job Description

Join Us in Shaping the Future of Animal Health

Our company is investing $895 million in expanding our manufacturing and research & development facilities in De Soto, Kansas — the state’s largest economic development project to date.

Job Summary:

As an Associate Director Operational Excellence , you will be part of a world-class team at our Center of Excellence in the Animal Health Corridor, contributing directly to the production of veterinary products that improve animal health and welfare globally.

In this role, you would work as a Lean Practitioner/Coach and Project/Program Manager. As an internal lean practitioner and coach, you will identify, analyze, act upon, and instruct others on improvements both strategically and based on daily problems. In this position, you will lead or be involved with teams on all facets of the value stream to improve business outcomes.   You will apply lean tools, thinking, and change management methodologies as you develop colleagues at all levels so that continuous improvement is in everyone's DNA.
As a project and program manager, you will lead projects to improve supply, increase productivity/reduce cost. You will lead teams with value-scouting exercises and lead more complex projects to achieve business outcomes.

Primary Responsibilities:

- Initiate, implement, and coach improvement projects using Lean tools (Standardization, 5S, Poke Yoke, Kaizens, Value Stream Mapping, Visual Management, etc.) to create flow and work smarter to improve performance, safety, quality, delivery, and cost.
- Hands-on support for operational problems and cross-functional investigations by conducting thorough scientific problem-solving techniques.
- Coach lean roadmaps and provide training.
- Continue to develop yourself in lean, inclusion, and change management. With this knowledge, you develop colleagues at all organizational levels by leading by example during improvement initiatives and coaching sponsors and stakeholders.

Primary Responsibilities of Project/Program Manager:

- Demonstrated senior leadership behaviors

- Facilitating value scouting workshops at sites.
- Project lead on larger cost savings projects.
- Lead regional cost-saving project governance and reporting.
- Additional duties as assigned

Required Experience and Skills:

- Bachelor's degree in project management, biology, engineering, or a relevant field.
- 5-7 years of demonstrable work experience with continuous improvement in one of the following fields: biopharmaceuticals, manufacturing, or quality.
- Experience in coaching staff in incorporating continuous improvement into their departments.
- Experience in facilitating project teams and project management.
- Result-oriented and able to manage many different tasks/projects and demonstrated ability to adapt to changes in priorities.
- Proficient in working with data, making trends visible, and performing data analysis.
- Proficient with Microsoft Office (Outlook, Word, Excel, Project, etc.)
- Team player with a "go-to-the-shop-floor" attitude, analytical & eager to learn.
- A pleasant, communicative skilled personality who can connect and coach colleagues in production as well as within management. Demonstrated ability to coach and influence management and change management.
- Experience with deploying and coaching lean in multiple environments
- Demonstrated use of all commonly used lean tools and concepts.
- Experience deploying strategy (Hoshin Kanri, Policy Deployment) and A3 Thinking in multiple levels of an organization.

Preferred Experience and Skills:

- Master's degree in management or business.
- Project Management Certification
- Formal training in Lean

Required Skills:
Lean Methodologies, Manufacturing, Manufacturing Operations, Manufacturing Production, Manufacturing Productivity, Operational Excellence (OpEx), Process Efficiency Improvements, Process Improvements, Process Optimization, Process Standardization, Project Management

jobs.title: Sr. Manager, Strategic Planning
jobs.description:
Job Description

Role Purpose
The Strategy Manager will serve as a core strategic intelligence & insight partner , providing senior leadership with real-time strategic insights to inform long-term strategic direction , expand near-term decision options , and shape company China strategy .

This role will build a holistic view on China macro dynamics, global perspectives on China market, China pharmaceutical market dynamics, competitive intelligence , monitoring these trends and translating into clear strategic implications, options, and recommendations for China.

Key Responsibilities
- China Macro Dynamics & Global Perspectives on China market
- Monitor China macro dynamics, and identify potential opportunities and risks for China
- China Pharmaceutical Industry & Long‑Term Strategy Insight
- Track and analyze China Pharmaceutical Industry trends , develop a holistic, forward‑looking view in close partnership with cross-functional teams
- Synthesize disparate signals into clear strategic narratives
- Competitive & Peer Intelligence (MNC and Local)
- Monitor strategic movements of leading pharmaceutical/biotech players
- Translate competitor activity into actionable strategic implications, risks, and opportunities for China
- Financial Performance & Market Signal Tracking
- Analyze annual and quarterly performance results
- Communicate concise insights on implications to China
- Group‑Level Strategy Synthesis & Leadership Engagement
- Integrate insights across macro trends, industry dynamics, competitor intelligence into a coherent strategic view
- Act as a trusted thought partner to leadership on evolving strategic topics

Qualifications
- Advanced degree in life sciences, medicine, pharmacy, or related field; MBA or equivalent business training preferred
- 6–10+ years of experience in pharma strategy, consulting, corporate strategy, or commercial excellence
- Strong understanding of China pharma market dynamics and MNC operating models
- Demonstrated ability to synthesize complex information into clear executive insights

Critical Capabilities
- Strong strategic thinking with external orientation
- Excellent written and verbal executive communication
- Solid analytic ability to connect commercial, financial, and industry signals
- High learning agility and comfort with ambiguity
- Intellectual curiosity and strategic insight
- Hands-on, proactive, and execution-oriented mindset

jobs.title: Associate Director, Strategic Planning
jobs.description:
Job Description

Corporate Strategic PMO provides enterprise-level governance and strategic project management to ensure the successful delivery and realization of the company’s strategy and highest strategic priorities. The role partners with senior leaders to translate strategy and strategic priorities into executable tasks, drive cross-functional alignment and delivery discipline, surface opportunities and risks early, and provide insights that accelerate high-quality management decisions.

Core responsibilities
Corporate Strategic Priorities QBR governance
- Translate enterprise strategic priorities into clear QBR narratives and measurable OKRs with chapter owners; ensure consistent interpretation and alignment across functions.
- Lead quarterly QBR planning and assessment; run the governance cadence and cross-functional alignments, decision-making; surface cross-BU dependencies, constraints, delivery risks and support needed.
- Identify emerging opportunities and leadership-ready strategic insights by synthesizing complex inputs to enable timely, high-quality management decisions.
- Establish a closed-loop feedback mechanism with key stakeholders; continuously improve QBR governance effectiveness, strategic fit, and execution quality.

Corporate Strategic Initiatives Realization
- Lead end-to-end strategic project management for corporate initiatives—set up the team, define scope and success metrics, build integrated plans and governance, manage interdependencies, and ensure disciplined delivery aligned to corporate priorities.
- Drive value realization by identifying opportunities, gaps, and cross-functional synergies; convert delivery signals into insights to accelerate high-quality leadership decisions.
- Own risks, issues, and critical path items through disciplined RAID management; drive early escalation, mitigation, and contingency planning to protect outcomes and timelines.

Agile Project Management Legacy & Capability Building
- Institutionalize enterprise agile delivery by establishing a professional agile project management framework, standards, and toolkit that is scalable and reusable.

Qualifications
- Bachelor’s degree or above; PMP / Scrum certification is a strong plus.
- 5+ years of project management experience within a pharmaceutical company (or closely related biotech/healthcare environment), with exposure to cross-functional stakeholders and regulated operations.
- Proven track record leading enterprise projects and transformational changes in complex, matrixed organizations, balancing speed, quality, and governance.\\
- Executive stakeholder management: influence across functions and communicate clearly with senior leadership using concise, decision-oriented narratives.
- Change leadership: design end‑to‑end adoption strategies, mobilize stakeholders, and build sustainable change capability.
- Strong command of PM tooling and data-driven governance; hands-on experience applying agile delivery methods in complex projects.
- Leadership maturity: strategic thinking, structured problem solving, influencing without authority, resilience, and strong compliance mindset.
- Expertise in strategy-to-execution operating models, project governance.
- Fluent in English and Mandarin for effective communication.

Required Skills:
Adaptability, Agile Project Management, Data-Driven Decision Making, Developing Proposals, Project Governance, Project Management, Resource Allocation, Risk Management, Stakeholder Management, Strategic Planning, Strategic Thinking

jobs.title: Student Placement - Pharmaceutical Business Operations & Project Management
jobs.description:
Job Description

12-Month Pharmaceutical Business Operations & Project Management placement offering hands-on experience in compliance, privacy, capability-building, business transformation, and cross-functional project delivery.

Financial Package: A highly competitive placement salary, plus a £2,000 sign-on bonus paid upon starting to assist with your transition.

The Governance, Process Assurance and Capabilities (GPAC) team brings together the UK Business Practices (BP), Medical Ethics & Integrity (ME&I), Privacy, and Foundational Capabilities functions. The team is responsible for governance frameworks, privacy, SOP management, process assurance, compliance with the ABPI Code of Practice, and employee capability development.
As part of GPAC, you will support initiatives that strengthen compliance, simplify processes, enhance capability-building, and enable colleagues across the organisation to deliver high-quality work to the highest standards.

This role will be based in our modern state-of-the-art co-working facilities in Moorgate, London. This site, at the heart of London provides fantastic amenities, support services and collaborative workspaces with convenient transport links.

We are a global biopharmaceutical leader committed to enhancing the lives of individuals through a diverse portfolio of prescription medicines, oncology treatments, life-saving vaccines, and animal health products. Our unwavering dedication to delivering innovative solutions is the driving force behind everything we do.

Responsibilities:
- Develop an understanding of governance, process assurance, privacy, compliance, and capability-building activities within a leading healthcare organisation.
- Support the delivery of compliance, governance, and privacy initiatives that help ensure adherence to internal policies, industry regulations, and the ABPI Code of Practice.
- Contribute to business improvement projects by supporting the adoption of innovative technologies, process simplification, automation, and AI-enabled solutions.
- Assist in the design and delivery of training and capability-building programmes to help colleagues develop the knowledge and skills required to perform their roles effectively.
- Partner with Medical Affairs, Corporate Affairs, Marketing, and other cross-functional teams to deliver strategic projects and build strong stakeholder management, communication, and presentation skills.
- Participate in patient engagement and other cross-functional initiatives, while taking on stretch assignments to support personal and professional development.

Requirements :
- You must be currently studying at a UK university and will be looking to complete a 12-month student internship as part of your undergraduate degree.
- Working towards a B.Sc. in life science, Pharmacy or equivalent healthcare qualification

- Project management skills, with experience delivering initiatives from start to finish against clear goals and objectives.
- Strong planning and organisational skills.
- Strong numerical, analytical, and IT skills.
- An interest or previous experience in governance, process assurance, compliance, privacy, or training, with a willingness to learn and develop in these areas.

jobs.title: Senior Director, Business Platform Strategy & Operations
jobs.description:
Job Description

Reporting to the   Regulatory Innovation & Information Management (RIIM)   Department Lead, this strategic leadership position oversees the end-to-end operations and management of an assigned sub-unit. As an active member of the   RIIM Leadership Team , the role collaborates closely with department leadership to define, execute, and govern a harmonized Regulatory digital strategy. The incumbent leads a cross-functional workforce of internal employees, contractors, and external vendors to drive day-to-day business systems, operational processes, and innovative capabilities while ensuring strict regulatory compliance, quality governance, and proactive risk mitigation. Additionally, this leader maintains full operational accountability for subunit financial management—including vendor contracts, purchase orders, and budget administration—as well as talent acquisition and workforce planning.

Responsibilities:

Regulatory Platform Operations & Optimization
- Act as a horizontal platform integrator across RIIM business systems, driving consistency and interoperability
- Drive platform lifecycle management, including releases, enhancements, and cross-system coordination
- Maintain governance frameworks to ensure consistency, compliance, and performance
- Partner with RIIM Business System Owners (BSOs), business stakeholders, IT and external vendors (e.g., Veeva) to shape platform roadmap, AI capabilities, and innovation priorities
- Ensure platforms are optimized for scalability, usability, and regulatory compliance
- Ensure integration and alignment across systems, data, and processes
- Accountable for Regulatory systems Business Continuity Plans (BCP), including annual readiness, scenario planning, and incident coordination
- Lead a centralized capability for systems adoption, user analytics, and insights generation
- Define and monitor KPIs for systems usage, adoption, and value delivery
- Use analytics to: Identify adoption gaps and drive targeted interventions, Quantify ROI from digital initiatives, Inform prioritization of enhancements and investments
- Enable data-driven continuous improvement, leveraging automation and AI where applicable
- As applicable provide Business System Ownership (BSO) for cross-cutting RIIM tools and capabilities (e.g., IPV Dashboard, Veeva AI solutions)

GRACS Digital Strategy Execution & System Communications
- Help translate GRACS Digital Strategy into execution
- Lead coordinated system communications, release readiness, and change enablement
- Ensure consistent stakeholder engagement and alignment across functions and regions
- Help drive a cohesive, user experience across regulatory platforms

GRACS Process–System Integration
- Ensure system capabilities and constraints support the designed process
- Support the Global Process Owner model

Education:
- BA or BS in Scientific, Business Operations, or Information Technology related degrees; minimum MS or equivalent

Required Experience and Skills:
- 10+ years working within a Regulatory operations role
- 5+ years of leading teams and a hybrid organization of employees, contractors, and vendors.
- Significant experience in Veeva RIM operations
- Experience with innovation strategy, implementation, and operations of digital solutions in a regulated environment
- Expertise in regulatory capabilities, operations, and business processes
- Strong experience in working closely with Functional Business area users, IT, Finance, HR, and vendors
- Ability to drive Corrective Action and Preventive Actions (CAPAs)/Non-Compliance Investigation Report (NCIRs) resolutions, Partner audits and Health Authority Inspections
- Ability to represent the organization at internal and external forums on RIM related topics
- Executive presence (writing and oral presentation)
- Demonstrated collaborative skills and ability to work in cross-functional and international environments
- Solid knowledge of regulatory processes, with a technology-process optimization mindset
- Demonstrated ability to recruit, train, and develop staff, to motivate others and drive continuous improvement
- Flexibility to operate in a matrix-managed environment and to support staff in that same environment
- Strategic Execution – Translates strategy into scalable, measurable outcomes
- Operational Excellence – Ensures disciplined, efficient, and compliant system operations
- Value Realization – Demonstrates measurable impact from technology investments
- Drives Transformation – Leads large-scale change through digital, data, and innovation

Business Alignment, Business Process Design, Contingency Plan, Decision Making, Executive Presence, Governance Framework, Interpersonal Relationships, Investments Analysis, Legal Compliance, Negotiation, People Leadership, Project Appraisals, Project Development, Project Planning, Regulatory Affairs Management, Regulatory Communications, Regulatory Compliance, Regulatory Experience, Regulatory Processes, Stakeholder Engagement, Stakeholder Management, Strategic Planning, Strategic Thinking, Strategy Deployment

jobs.title: Director, Operations - Pharm Ops
jobs.description:
Job Description

At our company, we aspire to be the premier research-intensive biopharmaceutical company, using the power of leading-edge science to save and improve lives around the world. We are at the forefront of research to deliver innovative health solutions that advance the prevention and treatment of diseases in people and animals.

Join a purpose-built, agile small molecule manufacturing site where your work will help bring important medicines to patients in the U.S. This facility is designed to move quickly and reliably, receiving technology transfers from commercialization sites and fast-following into production with a focus on quality, safety, and operational excellence.

At our site, you’ll be part of a team committed to creating a safe, environmentally responsible, and compliant workplace where people can do their best work. We are building deep small molecule expertise in the U.S., and we want team members who are excited to grow their skills, help improve how we operate, and contribute to a site positioned for future growth.

Reports To:
Site Ops Lead

Job Purpose:
The Director, IPT Leader, Pharm Ops provides leadership, technical and operational expertise to the Integrated Process Team (IPT) supporting the Pharmaceutical Operations manufacturing value stream at the Elkton, VA site. This role is accountable for shaping the future operating model for our new small molecule pharmaceutical manufacturing facility, including project and site readiness, organizational design, and the establishment of operating rhythms, governance, IPT culture, Ways of Working, and performance standards.
In the early project phases, the incumbent will lead strategic and tactical planning, cross-functional coordination, and project management activities required to support successful site build-out and operational ramp-up. As the site matures, the role will transition into full IPT leadership, accountable for safe, compliant, reliable, and efficient pharmaceutical operations, delivery performance, continuous improvement, stewardship, and people development. The incumbent serves as a member of the site leadership team and ensures alignment of site priorities with divisional and company strategies.

Primary Responsibilities:

Site Leadership and Strategy
- Serve as a member of the Site Leadership Team and help align IPT priorities with site and company strategy.

- Provide direction to establish tactical and strategic plans that support Pharm Ops ramp-up and long-term operational success.

- Partner across the site and with above-site teams to ensure strong coordination, decision-making, and execution.

- Represent the IPT and the site as needed with internal stakeholders and external partners.

Future-State Operating Model and Ramp-Up
- Lead the development of the future-state operating model for Pharm Ops at Elkton, VA.

- Support site start-up, ramp-up, and operational readiness activities through project leadership and cross-functional coordination.

- Help define organizational structure, organizational culture, operating rhythms, governance, and capability needs for the evolving site.

- Ensure readiness plans, risk assessments, and implementation plans are developed and executed effectively.

Operations Excellence and Delivery
- Ensure safe, compliant, reliable, and right-first-time pharmaceutical operations in support of production and supply objectives.

- Lead operational reviews and daily management routines to maintain visibility to performance, issues, and priorities.

- Drive structured problem solving and the use of performance metrics to identify trends, action plans, and opportunities for improvement.

- Support production planning, resource deployment, and issue resolution to meet site objectives.

- Promote lean thinking and continuous improvement to improve flow, throughput, right-first-time performance, and operational stability.

Financial Stewardship
- Support and/or own budget planning and financial stewardship for the IPT, including operating and capital spend.

- Partner with site leadership to identify opportunities for productivity, efficiency, and cost improvement.

- Ensure resources are allocated effectively to support current and future business needs.

Quality and Safety Stewardship
- Promote a strong quality culture and support a state of permanent inspection readiness.

- Ensure cGMP compliance and effective management of deviations, investigations, and corrective actions.

- Partner with Quality, EHS, Engineering, Technical, and Supply Chain teams to support site priorities and maintain strong compliance standards.

- Ensure appropriate training, documentation, and change management practices are in place to support safe and compliant operations.

- Champion a strong safety culture and support risk management activities across the IPT.

People Leadership
- Lead, coach, and develop a team of leaders and contributors to build a high-performing organization.

- Foster a culture of accountability, collaboration, empowerment, and continuous learning.

- Support talent development, succession planning, and ongoing skill-building within the IPT.

- Communicate clearly and regularly to align the team around priorities, expectations, and performance.

Minimum Required Education, Experience:
- Bachelor’s degree required. Chemistry, Chemical Engineering, Pharmaceutical Sciences, Engineering, or a related scientific/technical discipline is preferred.

- 10+ years of relevant experience in pharmaceutical, biotechnology or other regulated manufacturing environments.

- Leadership experience in one or more of the following areas: Manufacturing, Technical Operations, Quality Operations, Engineering, and/or Production Planning.

- Experience leading teams with direct and indirect reports.

- Strong knowledge of cGMP, quality systems, regulatory readiness, and safety/environmental practices.

- Demonstrated experience with operational planning, project leadership, or site ramp-up/start-up activities.

- Proven ability to lead in complex environments and manage multiple priorities across functions.

- Strong business acumen and experience with financial stewardship and resource planning.

- Experience applying Lean Six Sigma, continuous improvement, and structured problem-solving tools.

- Effective communication, coaching, and change leadership skills.

jobs.title: Director, Operations - API
jobs.description:
Job Description

At our company, we aspire to be the premier research-intensive biopharmaceutical company, using the power of leading-edge science to save and improve lives around the world. We are at the forefront of research to deliver innovative health solutions that advance the prevention and treatment of diseases in people and animals.

Join a purpose-built, agile small molecule manufacturing site where your work will help bring important medicines to patients in the U.S. This facility is designed to move quickly and reliably, receiving technology transfers from commercialization sites and fast-following into production with a focus on quality, safety, and operational excellence.

At our site, you’ll be part of a team committed to creating a safe, environmentally responsible, and compliant workplace where people can do their best work. We are building deep small molecule expertise in the U.S., and we want team members who are excited to grow their skills, help improve how we operate, and contribute to a site positioned for future growth.

Job Purpose:
The Director, IPT Leader, API provides leadership, technical and operational expertise to the Integrated Process Team (IPT) supporting the API manufacturing value stream at the Elkton, VA site. This role is accountable for shaping the future operating model for our new small molecule pharmaceutical manufacturing facility, including project and site readiness, organizational design, and the establishment of operating rhythms, governance, IPT culture, Ways of Working, and performance standards.
In the early project phases, the incumbent will lead strategic and tactical planning, cross-functional coordination, and project management activities required to support successful site build-out and operational ramp-up. As the site matures, the role will transition into full IPT leadership, accountable for safe, compliant, reliable, and efficient API operations, delivery performance, continuous improvement, stewardship, and people development.  The incumbent serves as a member of the site leadership team and ensures alignment of site priorities with divisional and company strategies.

Primary Responsibilities:
Site Leadership and Strategy
- Serve as a member of the Site Leadership Team and help align IPT priorities with site and company strategy.

- Provide direction to establish tactical and strategic plans that support API ramp-up and long-term operational success.

- Partner across the site and with above-site teams to ensure strong coordination, decision-making, and execution.

- Represent the IPT and the site as needed with internal stakeholders and external partners.

Future-State Operating Model and Ramp-Up
- Lead the development of the future-state operating model for the API operations at Elkton, VA.

- Support site start-up, ramp-up, and operational readiness activities through project leadership and cross-functional coordination.

- Help define organizational structure, organizational culture, operating rhythms, governance, and capability needs for the evolving site.

- Ensure readiness plans, risk assessments, and implementation plans are developed and executed effectively.

Operations Excellence and Delivery
- Ensure safe, compliant, and reliable and RFT API operations in support of production and supply objectives.

- Lead operational reviews and daily management routines to maintain visibility to performance, issues, and priorities.

- Drive structured problem solving and the use of performance metrics to identify trends, action plans, and opportunities for improvement.

- Support production planning, resource deployment, and issue resolution to meet site objectives.

- Promote lean thinking and continuous improvement to improve flow, throughput, right-first-time performance, and operational stability.

Financial Stewardship
- Support and/or own budget planning and financial stewardship for the IPT, including operating and capital spend.

- Partner with site leadership to identify opportunities for productivity, efficiency, and cost improvement.

- Ensure resources are allocated effectively to support current and future business needs.

Quality and Safety Stewardship
- Promote a strong quality culture and support a state of permanent inspection readiness.

- Ensure cGMP compliance and effective management of deviations, investigations, and corrective actions.

- Partner with Quality, EHS, Engineering, Technical, and Supply Chain teams to support site priorities and maintain strong compliance standards.

- Ensure appropriate training, documentation, and change management practices are in place to support safe and compliant operations.

- Champion a strong safety culture and support risk management activities across the IPT.

People Leadership
- Lead, coach, and develop a team of leaders and contributors to build a high-performing organization.

- Foster a culture of accountability, collaboration, empowerment, and continuous learning.

- Support talent development, succession planning, and ongoing skill-building within the IPT.

- Communicate clearly and regularly to align the team around priorities, expectations, and performance.

​ Minimum Required Education, Experience:
- Bachelor’s degree required. Chemistry, Chemical Engineering, Pharmaceutical Sciences, Engineering, or a related scientific/technical discipline is preferred.

- 10+ years of relevant experience in pharmaceutical or other regulated manufacturing environments.

- Leadership experience in one or more of the following areas: Manufacturing, Technical Operations, Quality Operations, Engineering, and/or Production Planning.

- Experience leading teams with direct and indirect reports.

- Strong knowledge of cGMP, quality systems, regulatory readiness, and safety/environmental practices.

- Demonstrated experience with operational planning, project leadership, or site ramp-up/start-up activities.

- Proven ability to lead in complex environments and manage multiple priorities across functions.

- Strong business acumen and experience with financial stewardship and resource planning.

- Experience applying Lean Six Sigma, continuous improvement, and structured problem-solving tools.

- Effective communication, coaching, and change leadership skills.

Preferred Qualifications:
- Master’s degree in Science, Engineering, Business, or a related discipline.

- Experience in small molecule API manufacturing or commercial pharmaceutical operations.

- Prior experience supporting a manufacturing site start-up, transformation, or ramp-up.

- Experience developing future-state operating models, organizational structures, or operational governance systems.

- Lean Six Sigma certification or deep practical application of Lean tools.

- Experience in a highly matrixed global manufacturing environment.

- Demonstrated success in talent development, employee engagement, and succession planning.

- Experience with capacity planning, capital planning, supply planning, and S&OP.

- Familiarity with inspection readiness, deviation management, and broader quality systems in a regulated environment.

This is a unique opportunity to help define and lead the future of a growing API site from the ground up. You’ll have the chance to influence how the site operates, build a strong team, and contribute to the delivery of high-quality medicines for patients around the world.
If you are a strategic leader with deep operational experience, a passion for developing teams, and a strong commitment to quality and excellence, we encourage you to apply.

jobs.title: Executive Director, Operations
jobs.description:
Job Description

Executive Director, Operations – M4 – Boxmeer, The Netherlands
A highly strategic leadership opportunity has arisen for an Executive Director, Operations at our largest and most complex Animal Health manufacturing site globally, in Boxmeer.

Reporting to the Site Lead, this role provides single-point accountability for the Run System (Manufacturing Operations), leading execution across Integrated Production Teams (IPTs) and Operations Services, with a team of approx.. 1000 colleagues.
The role has full accountability for four Integrated Production Teams (Antigen, Live, IVP, and Packaging) and Operations Services, representing the complete Manufacturing Operations (Run System) at the site.
The Executive Director ensures the safe, compliant, reliable, and cost-effective execution of manufacturing, sustaining predictable delivery of supply in alignment with the site operating model.
This role is explicitly defined as the owner of execution performance (SQDC) within the Boxmeer system-based operating model. In this capacity, the Executive Director provides leadership continuity and representing the site in designated forums where required.
Bring energy, knowledge, innovation to carry out the following:
- Own end-to-end Manufacturing execution performance, ensuring consistent and sustainable delivery across Safety, Quality, Delivery, and Cost (SQDC), and reinforcing a culture of accountability and operational discipline.
- Lead and integrate four Integrated Production Teams (Antigen, Live, IVP, Packaging) and Operations Services into a cohesive execution system, driving alignment, clarity of ownership, and high performance across day and shift organizations.
- Execute the site production plan as defined by Supply Chain with rigor and discipline, proactively identifying constraints, escalating risks, and ensuring transparent performance tracking.
- Ensure full GMP compliance and permanent inspection readiness, embedding 'Safety First, Quality Always' behaviors and reinforcing regulatory excellence at all levels of the organization.
- Drive operational excellence, embedding continuous improvement into daily operations and delivering measurable gains in productivity, yield, and cycle time.
- Own operational stability by strengthening right-first-time performance, reducing variability, and ensuring robust deviation management and root cause resolution.
- Lead operational risk management with a proactive mindset, ensuring timely identification, escalation, and resolution of issues impacting execution and supply reliability.
- Ensure production and project milestones are achieved through planning, effective decision making and execution of integrated overall program schedule
- Ensure readiness and flawless execution of manufacturing campaigns, including clinical, PPQ, and commercial batches, delivering right-first-time outcomes.
- Drive standardization, execution and operational excellence by applying Lean principles to foster continuous improvement mindset to deliver a productive and cost-efficient operating model.
- Provide clear direction and definition of any new project scope, goals and deliverables, to the site and cross-functional sub-teams on an on-going basis – ensure consistent delivery on projects and activities that has been agreed.
- Manage financial forecasts and workload to achieve departmental headcount and cost improvements
- Embed a strong technical and digital mindset within the organization, staying up to date with emerging technologies that will benefit the wider organization and manufacturing processes.
- Build and develop high-performing teams, strengthening leadership capability across IPTs and Operations Services to sustain performance and scalability.
- Foster an inclusive, accountable, and performance-driven culture aligned with Enterprise Leadership Skills, reinforcing ownership and decision clarity.
- Serve on the Site Leadership Team for Operations to develop and deliver toward site and organizational priorities and strategy.

General competencies:
- Effective leadership and interpersonal skills, including leading and coaching direct team to drive a high performance organizational culture that accommodates rapid growth and highly dynamic operating execution. A role model for the  Enterprise Leadership Skills and Ways of Working. Growth mindset with a global perspective.
- Ability to lead large-scale manufacturing organizations with clear accountability for execution performance and outcomes, and to influence across organizational layers, as well as above site and externally with partners.
- Strong system thinker capable of operating within defined system boundaries while ensuring effective cross-functional collaboration.
- Proven capability to translate strategy into disciplined execution, driving ownership and eliminating ambiguity in decision-making.
- Effective communicator and influencer across all organizational levels, with the ability to align diverse stakeholders in a matrix environment.
- Data-driven decision-maker with strong analytical capabilities, enabling fact-based prioritization and performance management.

Technical competencies:
- Deep expertise in pharmaceutical, biologics and vaccine manufacturing within a GxP-regulated environment, with proven capabilities across multi-product and multi-technology operations, including antigen, live and inactivated vaccines, pharmaceuticals and packaging environments.
- Extensive experience in operational excellence methodologies (Lean, Six Sigma, MPS) and their application in complex manufacturing settings.
- Experience managing large-scale, shift-based manufacturing operations with high complexity and regulatory requirements.
- Strong knowledge of global regulatory expectations and successful engagement in inspections with health authorities.
- Proven track-record in project management, ensuring production and project milestones are achieved through planning, effective decision making and execution of integrated overall program schedule.
- Capacity to operate effectively in an international matrix organization, exhibit strong leadership influence, and willingness to challenge respectfully and shape business strategy.
- Sound judgment and comfortable operating in a challenging, fast-paced and sometimes ambiguous environment.
- Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, and the ability to work independently, and make decisions in a constantly changing environment.
- Proven ability to lead transformational change effectively.
- Solid financial acumen, with demonstrated ability to manage costs, improve productivity, and maintain cost competitiveness.

Minimum Education/Experience:
- Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Life Sciences, or a related discipline.
- Minimum of 15 years of experience in pharmaceutical or biotech manufacturing operations, including leadership of large-scale organizations.
- Demonstrated track record of sustained operational performance in complex manufacturing environments, including technology transfer experience.

jobs.description:
Job Description

Welcome to our team

We are a worldwide research-based company, engaged in the discovery, development, manufacturing and marketing of Animal Health products. For their Research- and Development site in Schwabenheim / Germany, we are looking for a highly motivated and qualified Senior Specialist FP&A, which is part of the finance team that is supporting the financial planning and analysis for R&D Animal Health and is the financial business partner to our local teams and senior management.

About the role

As a Senior Specialist Financial Planning & Analysis you will serve as the key finance business partner to the Management / Business partners in Schwabenheim and some small R&D-organizations outside Germany.
You will oversee the financial performance of our R&D business across the world and manage the local expense budget including Headcount and Capital investments.
In this role, you will provide financial leadership and robust decision support to leading Business partners, enabling them to optimize R&D results. You will also deliver ad‑hoc analyses to identify opportunities for decisions, efficiency, and optimization.
Additionally, you will act as the Site subject matter expert for headcount and capital planning and reporting and lead the monthly P&L-reporting to US Headquarters.
This role reports to the Finance Director, Animal Health R&D.
This role is key member of the Global Finance R&D core team.

- Strong business partnering for senior management in R&D and Global Support functions
- Coordinate the annual budgeting and quarterly forecasting cycles for the responsible R&D functions in various legal entities, ensuring timely and accurate submissions in SAC-P.
- Support and guide the local Business partners for accurate reporting and planning of Costs, Headcount and Capital investments
- Manage site budget expenses by ensuring accurate cost allocation and analyzing variances versus budget, forecast, and prior-year actuals.
- Ensure consistency in reporting across the R&D business and drive optimizations where needed.
- Preparation and analysis of monthly, quarterly and annual financial statements
- Reporting and present insights and results to the R&D management
- Proactively identify opportunities to improve processes, increase efficiency, and foster a culture of continuous improvement and innovation.

- Support in investment decisions and project evaluations.
- Ensure good quality in reporting with clear narrative.

Your skills
- Independent, self-reliant, structured and goal-oriented way of working as well as good analytical skills

jobs.title: Program Manager Engineering
jobs.description:
Job Description

Voor onze Animal Health locatie in Boxmeer zoeken wij een Programma Manager

Welkom in ons team

Binnen onze Animal Health-organisatie in Boxmeer is de afdeling Capital Investments verantwoordelijk voor het beheer en de uitvoering van investeringsprojecten. Onder deze afdeling valt het team Site Engineering, dat technische projecten realiseert op het gebied van nieuwbouw, renovatie en verbouwing op de locaties Boxmeer en De Bilt. Dit omvat onder meer bouwkundige, proces technische en installatieprojecten, evenals verpakkingsconcepten. Het team levert hiervoor projectmanagement- en projectengineering-support.

Over de functie

In deze rol ben je de single point of contact voor een aan jou toegewezen interne klant (Productie-Unit of Center of Excellence). Ten behoeve van en in nauwe samenwerking met deze klant beheer je een portfolio aan (technische) investerings-, renovatie- verbouwingsprojecten en geef je functioneel leiding aan projectleiders en/of (ingehuurde) engineersteams. In deze rol werk je nauw samen met een grote diversiteit aan interne (e.g. Asset Management, Facilities , Environment, Health & Safety, Manufacturing (EHS)) en externe stakeholders (leveranciers, contractors ) en rapporteer je aan de Manager Site Engineering.

Primaire verantwoordelijkheden

- Zorgt in nauw overleg met de interne klant voor het samenstellen en maandelijkse update van het projectportfolio en is verantwoordelijk voor het realiseren van de geplande capital investments volgens dit plan;

- Stemt samen met de interne klant de eisen en wensen vanuit de business af en vertaalt deze samen met stake-holders van de site naar investeringsbehoeften waarbij risico’s, compliance, prioriteiten worden vastgesteld;

- Draagt zorg voor de initiatie en scoping van projecten van zijn klanten;

- Verantwoordelijk voor het aansturen van de projectleiders die binnen zijn projectportfolio werken;

- Regelt en coördineert in nauw overleg met de Planner en Resource Manager de bezetting van de projectteams binnen zijn project-portfolio;

- Is binnen zijn projectportfolio eindverantwoordelijk voor de kwaliteit van de door SE-afdeling uitgevoerde werkzaamheden, hierbij rekening houdend met o.a. de Good Manufacturing Practice (GMP) principes- en EHS-regels en Engineering Policies / Guidelines ;

- Is eindverantwoordelijk voor de veiligheid op de projectlocaties binnen zijn projectportfolio;

- Treedt binnen de afd. SE op als kennisdrager van één of meerdere specialismen (denk aan standaarden of een technisch specialisme);

- Is eindverantwoordelijk voor project scoping , haalbaarheidsstudies, concept- en basic engineering, budget-raming, planning en investeringsaanvragen t.b.v. projecten in zijn projectportfolio;

- Is de interface tussen de klant, Site Engineering-projectteam en alle overige in het project benodigde stake-holders van de site;

- Overlegt samen met de manager van Site Engineering en andere Lead-Engineers de personele, organisatorische en functionele zaken en stemt deze af op de behoefte van de site.

Jouw profiel

- Een afgeronde opleiding op Academisch/HBO niveau in een relevante technische richting;

- Ruime en succesvolle ervaring met het initiëren, managen en opleveren van technische ( capex ) projecten in een relevante productieomgeving ( pharma , biotech , kleine chemie, food);

- Zeer sterk ontwikkelde project- en stakeholdermanagementvaardigheden, je weet op handige wijze verbinding te maken op verschillende niveaus;

- VCA I en II gecertificeerd, kennis van EHS-regelgeving en bekend met Lean Six Sigma principes;

- Uitstekende mondelinge en schriftelijke vaardigheden in Nederlands en Engels;

- Woonachtig op een redelijke afstand van Boxmeer (deze rol vraagt om minimaal 4 dagen per week aanwezigheid).

Wij bieden

Werken bij onze organisatie betekent samen werken aan gezondheid in een internationale werkomgeving met toegewijde collega’s. Je krijgt alle ruimte om jezelf te ontwikkelen en te laten zien wie jij bent. Verder kan je rekenen op aantrekkelijke arbeidsvoorwaarden:

- Een marktconform salaris, afhankelijk van jouw kennis en ervaring.

- Een eindejaarsuitkering van 3% en een jaarlijkse bonus op basis van individuele en bedrijfsresultaten.

- Minimaal 35,5 vakantiedagen.

- Reiskostenvergoeding en een solide pensioenregeling.

- Een hoogwaardig bedrijfsrestaurant met dagelijks verse en gezonde opties.

- Uitstekende bereikbaarheid: het treinstation bevindt zich direct bij onze hoofdingang en er is voldoende parkeergelegenheid.

- Een bijdrage aan je persoonlijke sportabonnement ter ondersteuning van je vitaliteit.

- Een prachtig privépark op het terrein, ideaal voor een wandeling, pauze of moment van ontspanning.

- Ondersteuning voor mentaal welzijn via Lyra Health, voor jou en je gezinsleden.

- Toegang tot een speciale gebeds- en meditatieruimte.

- Ruime mogelijkheden voor loopbaangroei dankzij de omvang van de locatie en de aanwezigheid van veel disciplines en wereldwijde afdelingen in Boxmeer.

- Een werkplek binnen een organisatie die blijft groeien en zich blijft ontwikkelen.

jobs.title: Lean Six Sigma Specialist (Manufacturing)
jobs.description:
Job Description

Are you ready to drive operational excellence in a dynamic manufacturing environment? Join our Animal Health site in Boxmeer and lead Lean Six Sigma initiatives that improve performance, empower teams, and deliver sustainable business results.

For our animal health location in Boxmeer we are currently recruiting a: Lean Six Sigma Specialist (Manufacturing)

Welcome to our team
The production facilities in Boxmeer are part of the global Animal Health manufacturing network. We produce and package animal health products according to GMP standards. We work according to the Production System (MPS), which is based on Lean Six Sigma, continuous improvement, and inclusion principles.
The IPT Live Vaccines organisation consists of two production departments and support teams for Maintenance & Reliability and Improvement. The IPT is responsible for the preparation of live bulk vaccines, aseptic filling and freeze-drying of live attenuated vaccines. With approximately 270 FTE, IPT Live offers a dynamic environment where operational excellence, collaboration and shop floor engagement are key.

Purpose of the Role
The Lean Six Sigma Specialist plays a critical role in driving operational excellence within IPT Live by leading strategic improvement initiatives that enhance performance, efficiency, quality, and ways of working. As a highly visible presence on the shop floor, you will work closely with operational teams to identify opportunities, translate insights into sustainable improvement actions, and address complex challenges through structured problem-solving and data-driven decision-making.
In this role, you will act as a catalyst for change by coaching teams, developing Lean Six Sigma capabilities, and fostering a culture of continuous improvement. Through strong stakeholder management and cross-functional collaboration, you will bring people together around shared objectives, ensure alignment on priorities, and help deliver measurable and lasting business results. By applying Lean, Six Sigma, and MPS principles, you will support IPT Live in achieving its operational and strategic goals while continuously raising the organization's improvement maturity.

Tasks and responsibilities
- Design, implement, and continuously improve the Lean Six Sigma programme within IPT Live, ensuring alignment with MPS principles and business priorities.
- Build Lean Six Sigma capabilities across the organization by establishing standards, providing training, coaching colleagues, and leading by example.
- Maintain a strong shop floor presence to understand operational challenges, identify improvement opportunities, and translate ideas into practical and sustainable solutions.
- Lead and support cross-functional improvement projects, investigations, and problem-solving efforts using data analytics, structured root cause analysis, and effective follow-up.
- Coach sponsors, project leaders, and practitioners in the application of Lean, Six Sigma, change management, and inclusion principles.
- Engage and influence stakeholders at all levels of the organization to build alignment, ownership, and commitment around improvement priorities.
- Use performance metrics, benchmarking, and data analysis to identify, prioritize, and address operational and business improvement opportunities.
- Collaborate with peers across the network to share best practices and contribute to global MPS and continuous improvement communities.
- Support IPT Live in achieving its business objectives by initiating, leading, and actively participating in improvement initiatives and ad hoc projects.

What we ask
- Bachelor's or Master's degree, demonstrating an academic level of thinking and problem-solving.
- Proven experience in establishing, leading, or making a significant contribution to Lean Six Sigma or continuous improvement programs within a manufacturing or operational environment.
- Lean Six Sigma Black Belt certification, or Green Belt certification with substantial practical experience and the willingness and capability to obtain Black Belt certification.
- Strong analytical, facilitation, project management, and stakeholder management skills.
- Excellent verbal and written communication skills in both Dutch and English.

What we offer
Working with us means contributing to animal health in an international environment alongside dedicated colleagues. You will have ample opportunities to grow, develop your skills, and make a meaningful impact. In addition, we offer an attractive benefits package, including:
- A competitive salary, depending on your knowledge and experience.
- A 3% year-end allowance and an annual bonus based on individual and company performance.
- At least 35.5 vacation days per year.
- Travel expense reimbursement and a strong pension plan.
- A high-quality company restaurant offering fresh and healthy options every day.
- Excellent accessibility, with a train station located directly at our main entrance and ample on-site parking.
- A contribution toward your fitness membership to support your wellbeing.
- Access to a beautiful private park on campus, ideal for a walk, break, or moment of relaxation.
- Mental wellbeing support through Lyra Health for you and your family members.

jobs.title: Operations Manager
jobs.description:
Job Description

Job Description:

This requisition is for both day shift and night shift positions.

This position is for a manufacturing leadership role as Operations Manager supporting the commercial-scale manufacture of vaccines and therapeutics at the Durham, NC site. The individual in this role must provide direction, coaching, and technical expertise to operations personnel responsible for the manufacturing processes. This individual must actively manage their assigned team to reliably support customer demand, including hiring as needed, employee development, routine 1:1 meetings and coaching, recognition, and performance management. Additionally, they must become proficient in the use of manufacturing systems and knowledgeable of site procedures in order to resolve process/equipment issues, minimize downtime, and ensure product quality.

Successful candidate(s) will be assigned to support one of the manufacturing factories located at the Durham, NC site.

Responsibilities include, but are not limited to:

Employee Development / People Management
- Develop, motivate, and manage a team to ensure reliable manufacturing process execution
- Assign yearly performance objectives for the team in alignment with department and site goals
- Provide regular feedback and coaching to employees on work performance
- Provide leadership to the team as needed based on the team’s capabilities and maturity
- Ensure on time approval of payroll activities using site approved software like ADP.

Process Execution / Continuous Improvement
- Provide a leadership presence on the manufacturing floor
- Champion standard work to drive consistent use of best practices across teams
- Regularly help the team troubleshoot issues to minimize downtime and maintain product quality
- Identify opportunities to improve the process (e.g. cycle times, ease of execution, reliability)
- Support work as needed to implement improvements (e.g. scheduling, staffing, protocol execution)
- Coach team members in executing smaller improvement projects in their operational area
- Represent Operations on project teams as needed

Communication
- Lead and support daily (Tier) meetings to facilitate flow of information up/down through the organization
- Hold regular team meetings to cascade information and collect team feedback
- Provide clear consistent communication from shift to shift
- Escalate issues as needed to ensure the right support/awareness is given to issues as they arise
- Serve as an Subject Matter Expert (SME) during tours to provide area/process overview information to visitors/auditors upon request

Quality & Safety Compliance
- Foster strong safety culture on the team through actions, coaching, and prioritization
- Coach individuals when reporting safety issues and completing corrective/preventative actions
- Drive culture of compliance through actions, consistent quality-driven decision making, and coaching of the team (e.g. documentation, housekeeping, area 5S, etc.)
- Participate in safety/regulatory audits (i.e. tours, topic discussion)

Financial
- Coach the team to ensure SAP transaction completion is timely and accurate
- Manage team staffing and overtime to support customer demand while meeting budget targets
- Recognize opportunities for cost savings and communicates them for potential project chartering

Education Minimum Requirement:
- High School Diploma/GED required

Required Experience and Skills:
- Minimum six (6) years of experience in a manufacturing, technical, support, or Military role or at least four (4) years of experience in a manufacturing, technical, support, or Military role with a Bachelor’s degree in Life Science or Engineering
- Must be willing to work a rotating shift schedule including but not limited to: - 2-3-3 rotation x 12.5 hr shifts (example 6:00AM to 6:30PM or 6:00PM – 6:30 AM). Note that this schedule does include working alternating weekends and holidays
- 4 day x 10.5 hr shifts with rotating weekend coverage. Note that this schedule does include working alternating weekends and holidays.
- 5 day x 8.5 hr shifts. Note that this schedule does include working holidays with weekend coverage required based on business needs.

- Ability to qualify and maintain gowning requirements to enter classified areas in the manufacturing area to provide shopfloor support
- Demonstrated ability to lead a team (i.e. experience leading directly as a supervisor/coach or indirectly as part of a project or through routine process execution)
- Ability to manage multiple priorities and coordinate people/resources to meet a production schedule
- Strong interpersonal, communication, and problem-solving skills

Preferred Experience and Skills:
- Previous supervisory experience
- Experience in a Good Manufacturing Practice (GMP)-regulated manufacturing environment
- Experience using electronic manufacturing systems (e.g. PAS-X, SAP, Delta-V, etc.)
- Experience interacting with regulatory auditors as part of area tours and/or topic discussion
- Lean Six Sigma certification  #MSJR #VetJobs #EBRG

jobs.title: Manager Operations
jobs.description:
Job Description

Wil jij een team en jezelf ontwikkelen in een dynamische, internationale farmaceutische productieomgeving, waarin geen dag hetzelfde is? Solliciteer dan direct!

Voor de IPT Blister zoeken we een: Manager Operations

Welkom in ons team
We hebben drie productieafdelingen in Haarlem en per afdeling Vaccines, Blister en Specialties, staan verpakkingslijnen die zeer divers zijn qua werking en technologie. Hiermee worden alle componenten en medicijnen verpakt en voorzien van bijsluiters tot het eindproduct dat iedereen kent van de apotheek. Samen met je collega-managers bent je verantwoordelijk voor 10 tot 12 verpakkingslijnen met in totaal circa 35 Operators

De functie
Als Manager Operations ben je verantwoordelijk voor onze dagelijkse productie, het is een shopfloor gerichte functie. Je focust je daarbij op de dagelijkse doelstellingen ten aanzien van veiligheid, kwaliteit, people management en een optimale planning. Een belangrijk aspect is dat jij samen met je team zorgt dat de gevraagde output wordt gehaald. Ook zorg jij ervoor dat je team wordt getraind om de lijnen te bedienen, te kunnen ombouwen en het TIER proces uit te voeren.
De Manager Operations rapporteert aan de Associate Director Operations. De productie vindt plaats in 3-ploegendienst.

Taken en verantwoordelijkheden
- Geef je leiding aan ongeveer 10-12 Operators en lever je een actieve bijdrage aan hun verdere persoonlijke ontwikkeling.
- Initieer en manage je verbeterprojecten op het gebied van techniek, kwaliteit en veiligheid aan de hand van MPS-methodieken.
- Zie je erop toe dat kwaliteitsprocedures en richtlijnen volgens Good Manufacturing Practice (GMP) worden gevolgd en dat je teamleden altijd veilig werken.
- Werk je samen met specialisten op het gebied van improvement, engineering, quality en EHS.
- Ben je verantwoordelijk voor het realiseren van de productie- en kostendoelstellingen zonder concessies te doen aan de veiligheid en kwaliteit van het product.

Jouw profiel
- Een afgeronde Bachelor (BSc) of Master (MSc) opleiding in een technische, bedrijfskundige, life sciences of aanverwante richting, óf
- Enkele jaren werkervaring als people manager en in staat om een team te coachen naar toenemende zelfstandigheid.
- Gesprekspartner voor alle niveaus waarbij je goed prioriteiten kunt stellen en onder tijdsdruk de juiste afwegingen kunt maken.
- Aantoonbare technische affiniteit en goede projectmanagement vaardigheden.
- Goede beheersing de Nederlandse en Engelse taal in woord en geschrift.

Wij bieden
Werken bij onze organisatie betekent samenwerken aan gezondheid in een internationale werkomgeving met toegewijde collega’s. Je krijgt alle ruimte om jezelf te ontwikkelen en te laten zien wie jij bent. Verder kun je rekenen op aantrekkelijke arbeidsvoorwaarden, waaronder:
- Een competitief salaris
- 35,5 vakantiedagen
- 8% vakantietoeslag en 3% eindejaarsuitkering
- Ploegentoeslag
- Een uitstekend pensioen
- Een bedrijfsrestaurant van hoge kwaliteit met elke dag verse en gezonde opties.
- Sportfaciliteiten op locatie met lessen in boksen, Zumba en Pilates.
- Uitstekende koffie bereid door een professionele barista.
- Game room met een pooltafel en een pingpongtafel.

- Toegang tot een aparte gebeds-/meditatieruimte.

jobs.title: Associate Director, Data Analytics & AI - Solution Architect
jobs.description:
Job Description

Associate Director, EIT, Data Analytics & AI, Solution Architect
The Opportunity
- Based in Hyderabad, join a global healthcare biopharma company and be part of a 130- year legacy of success backed by ethical integrity, forward momentum, and an inspiring mission to achieve new milestones in global healthcare.
- Be part of an organisation driven by digital technology and data-backed approaches that support a diversified portfolio of prescription medicines, vaccines, and animal health products.
- Drive innovation and execution excellence. Be a part of a team with passion for using data, analytics, and insights to drive decision-making, and which creates custom software, allowing us to tackle some of the world's greatest health threats.

Our Technology centers focus on creating a space where teams can come together to deliver business solutions that save and improve lives. An integral part of the company IT operating model, Tech centers are globally distributed locations where each IT division has employees to enable our digital transformation journey and drive business outcomes. These locations, in addition to the other sites, are essential to supporting our business and strategy.
A focused group of leaders in each tech center helps to ensure we can manage and improve each location, from investing in growth, success, and well-being of our people, to making sure colleagues from each IT division feel a sense of belonging to managing critical emergencies. And together, we must leverage the strength of our team to collaborate globally to optimize connections and share best practices across the Tech Centers.
Role Overview:
At our company, we are at the forefront of research to deliver innovative health solutions that advance the prevention and treatment of diseases in people and animals. One of the key priorities for our company is a significant focus on Data and its utilization as a Strategic asset to drive insight-driven decisions. The opportunity to accelerate our time to insights hinges on our ability to integrate, enrich and govern our disparate and evolving data sources, at speed and scale. The Enterprise IT Digital, Data and Analytics & AI team’s mission is to focus on driving these capabilities to increase utilization of data within the organization.
Are you passionate about designing innovative solutions that drive business success? Join us as a Solution Architect for Data Analytics & AI, where you will lead the development of forward-looking architecture that power our enterprise. As a strategic communicator and technical expert, you will collaborate across teams to ensure seamless integration and compliance. If you are ready to apply your expertise in AI and automation to make a meaningful impact, we encourage you to apply.
What will you do in this role:
- Design and evaluate scalable solution architectures that meet enterprise needs across Data & Analytics (DnA), Intelligent Automation (IA), and AI domains.
- Analyze current architectures to identify gaps and recommend improvements for scalability, performance, and cost efficiency, while defining and evolving target-state architectures for DnA and IA platforms across business functions.
- Collaborate with developers, product owners, and architects to ensure seamless integration and compliance, while championing governance practices, applying architectural frameworks, and driving innovative solutions.
- Monitor industry and technology trends to shape architecture roadmaps and guide adoption of emerging capabilities like GenAI and self-service analytics.
- Align solution architecture with business strategy, advocate for user-centric design principles and manage technical debt with remediation strategies.
- Evaluate the financial impact of architectural alternatives to ensure cost-effective, value-driven solutions.
- Lead agile delivery of reusable technology products that support long-term architectural vision and deliver incremental value.
- Promote DevSecOps, platform automation, and modern engineering practices to enhance delivery and operational excellence.
- Build strong networks across business and IT, actively contributing to Our communities of practice and architectural forums.

What Should you have:
- Bachelor’s degree concentration in Computer Science, Information Systems, or related field.
- 10+ years of experience spanning IT disciplines including solution architecture, systems integration, and end-to-end system design across data, application, and platform layers.
- Strong understanding of IT, Solution & Data architecture principles , data platforms, business process management and enterprise technology reuse
- Demonstrated ability to analyze, design, and implement solutions based on current and future state architectures and reference models
- Skilled in defining high-level requirements, guiding solution decisions, and providing architectural blueprints for engineering teams
- Proficient in Data and Analytics platforms, Intelligent Automation tools, Artificial Intelligence technologies and platforms, Data Lakehouse architecture, Data quality, Lineage & Cataloging tools
- Familiarity with cloud-native platforms (e.g., AWS, Azure), CI/CD pipelines, observability, infrastructure as code, GenAI, machine learning lifecycle, intelligent automation platforms, and orchestration frameworks
- Deep understanding of System Development Life Cycle(SDLC), SOX, GxP, and data privacy regulations in enterprise environments
- Strong leadership in strategic planning, innovation, talent development, and execution excellence
- Effective communicator with the ability to influence cross-functional teams, drive alignment with enterprise goals, and articulate architecture rationale and trade-offs to stakeholders with varying technical acumen

Preferred Qualifications:
- Proven ability to lead and manage cross-functional teams in a dynamic environment
- Advanced certifications in related fields such as TOGAF or other architecture related credentials, AI, Data Science, or Automation
- Functional familiarity with one or more enterprise platforms such as SAP, ServiceNow, Workday
- Experience architecting enterprise-scale data, AI, or automation solution(s) preferably in Life Sciences or equivalent regulated industries
- Proficiency in GenAI architecture and ability to articulate reference architecture for AI / LLMOps

Our technology teams operate as business partners, proposing ideas and innovative solutions that enable new organizational capabilities. We collaborate internationally to deliver services and solutions that help everyone be more productive and enable innovation.

Who we are:
We are known as Merck & Co., Inc., Rahway, New Jersey, USA in the United States and Canada and MSD everywhere else. For more than a century, we have been inventing for lives, bringing forward medicines and vaccines for many of the world's most challenging diseases. Today, our company continues to be at the forefront of research to deliver innovative health solutions and advance the prevention and treatment of diseases that threaten people and animals around the world.

What we look for:
Imagine getting up in the morning for a job as important as helping to save and improve lives around the world. Here, you have that opportunity. You can put your empathy, creativity, digital mastery, or scientific genius to work in collaboration with a diverse group of colleagues who pursue and bring hope to countless people who are battling some of the most challenging diseases of our time. Our team is constantly evolving, so if you are among the intellectually curious, join us—and start making your impact today.

jobs.description:
Job Description

Senior. Specialist , Data Enablement Lead (Supply Chain, Manufacturing focus)
The Opportunity
- Based in Hyderabad, join a global healthcare biopharma company and be part of a 130-year legacy of success backed by ethical integrity, forward momentum, and an inspiring mission to achieve new milestones in global healthcare.
- Be part of an organisation driven by digital technology and data-backed approaches that support a diversified portfolio of prescription medicines, vaccines, and animal health products.
- Drive innovation and execution excellence. Join a team that is passionate about using data, analytics, and insights to drive decision-making and create custom software, allowing us to tackle some of the world's greatest health threats.

Our Technology Centres focus on creating a space where teams can come together to deliver business solutions that save and improve lives. An integral part of our company's IT operating model, Tech Centres are globally distributed locations where each IT division has employees to enable our digital transformation journey and drive business outcomes. These locations, in addition to the other sites, are essential to supporting our business and strategy.
A focused group of leaders in each Tech Center helps ensure we can manage and improve each location, from investing in the growth, success, and well-being of our people to making sure colleagues from each IT division feel a sense of belonging, to managing critical emergencies. Together, we must leverage the strength of our team to collaborate globally to optimize connections and share best practices across the Tech Centres .
Role Overview
The Senior Specialist – Data Enablement Lead is accountable for enabling trusted, governed, reusable, and AI‑ready data products across Animal Health by providing standards, methods, platforms, guardrails, and enablement — while data ownership remains with Value Teams.
Operating within the Architecture, Integration, Data Engineering & Data Enablement (AIDE) organization, this role partners closely with Value Teams, platform teams, analytics and AI teams, and enterprise governance bodies to embed data enablement capabilities into business domains.
Working in a matrixed, domain‑centric environment, the Data Enablement Lead acts as a product manager for data enablement, translating governance and platform capabilities into scalable, consumable outcomes that accelerate business value, analytics, and AI adoption.

What will you do
- Define and drive the Data Enablement strategy for assigned data domains, aligned with Value Teams, Animal Health Data Platform and One Data Program objectives.
- Establish and enforce data enablement standards, guardrails, and design principles covering data quality, metadata, lineage, access, privacy, and AI readiness.
- Act as the AIDE liaison to Value Teams, co‑designing domain data products while maintaining clear separation between enablement and ownership.
- Enable self‑service data capabilities with guardrails, in collaboration with platforms, engineering, and security teams.
- Own and evolve data enablement roadmaps, prioritizing capabilities based on domain needs, adoption, and business value.
- Ensure data products are discoverable, trusted, reusable, and fit for advanced analytics and GenAI use cases.
- Partner with analytics, AI, and data science teams to ensure data enablement supports current and future AI needs.
- Define and track product‑style metrics (adoption, data quality, time‑to‑delivery, consumer satisfaction).
- Support domain governance councils, escalation paths, and cross‑domain alignment.

Your Daily Activities include, but are not limited to:
- Management: Lead the design and implementation of scalable, compliant data enablement capabilities aligned with business priorities. Support leadership vision and strategy for a federated, domain‑centric data operating model.
- Process and Insight: Translate governance and platform capabilities into repeatable enablement processes. Promote data‑driven decision‑making using metrics and insights from enablement outcomes.
- Product & Delivery: Operate with a data‑as‑a‑product mindset, managing enablement backlogs, roadmaps, and lifecycle evolution. Deliver incrementally using agile ways of working.
- Relationships: Build trusted partnerships with Value Teams, platform teams, analytics teams, and enterprise governance stakeholders. Influence without assuming data ownership.
- Organizational Change Management: Drive behavioral and cultural change toward reuse, self‑service, and product thinking. Act as a role model for modern data enablement and product leadership practices.
- Global & Enterprise Alignment: Ensure enablement approaches align with enterprise standards, platforms, and governance frameworks. Coordinate with central data and analytics organizations to avoid duplication and misalignment.
- Diversity & Inclusion: Respect and value diverse perspectives, fostering an inclusive and collaborative team environment

What should you have
- 5+ years of experience in data enablement, data governance, data management, analytics, or related data domains.

jobs.description:
Job Description

We are seeking an experienced commercial leader to join the two-year Commercial Leadership Development Program (CLDP), designed to accelerate enterprise leadership capability, expand cross-functional breadth, and prepare future leaders to drive strategic impact during a pivotal period of commercial transformation.

Over the course of the two-year journey, CLDP participants will complete three eight-month rotations aligned to enterprise priorities and individual development goals, with opportunities across marketing, marketing operations, sales operations, market access, launch excellence, and other critical commercial functions. Rotations are selected based on business need and are intended to build broad commercial acumen, strategic agility, and readiness for larger-scale leadership roles across Human Health.

** Interviews will be completed and offers extended by December 2026.  Selected candidates will start their new role in July 2027.

What you’ll do:
- Lead strategic and operational initiatives across rotation assignments, translating enterprise priorities into actionable plans and measurable business outcomes.

- Influence and partner across marketing, sales, market access, operations, analytics, medical, finance, legal, and compliance to drive aligned decision-making in a highly matrixed environment.

- Synthesize data, market dynamics, customer insights, and financial considerations into strategic recommendations that shape business decisions and resource trade-offs.

- Support critical launch planning, readiness, and execution activities, including risk identification, milestone management, and cross-functional coordination to improve launch success.

- A foundation for progression into broader commercial leadership roles through expanded network, enterprise exposure, and demonstrated delivery of results.

- Demonstrated commercial acumen, including understanding of company operations, financial performance, market dynamics, and industry trends.

- Strong understanding of the healthcare ecosystem, including customer, channel, payer, and reimbursement dynamics that influence commercial strategy and execution.

- Proven ability to influence without authority, navigate ambiguity, and lead through change in a matrixed and evolving business environment.

- Strong analytical capability and data-driven decision-making skills, including the ability to move from observation to insight to action.

Our ability to excel depends on the integrity, knowledge, imagination, skill, diversity, and teamwork of people like you. To this end, we strive to create an environment of mutual respect, encouragement, and teamwork. As part of our global team, you'll have the opportunity to collaborate with talented and dedicated colleagues while developing and expanding your career.

The Future Talent Program features internships that last up to 12 weeks and will include one or more projects. This opportunity within our manufacturing Division will provide you with hands-on experience in both project management, change management, as well as cross-functional collaboration.

Our Manufacturing Division is a team of dedicated, energetic individuals who are committed to being the most trusted supplier of pharmaceuticals and health products worldwide. Our facilities, along with our external contractors, suppliers, and partners, comprise an interdependent global manufacturing network committed to delivering a compliant, reliable supply to customers and patients on time, every time, across the globe.

The Manufacturing Strategy, Business Development and Alliances (MSBDA) group is responsible for the development and realization of the Manufacturing division and oversees core enterprise manufacturing functions. The team designs, executes, and monitors processes required to deliver our Manufacturing Division strategic portfolio commitments, as well as managing business development, strategic alliances, and manufacturing strategy.
