jobs.title: Learning & Development Lead (Manufacturing)
jobs.description:
Job Description

Join our fast-growing Animal Health organization and shape the learning and capability strategy that powers our ambitious transformation agenda.

For our Animal Health location Boxmeer, we are currently recruiting a Learning & Development Lead (Manufacturing)

Welcome to our team
Our Boxmeer site manufactures and packages animal health products according to Good Manufacturing Practices standards (GMP). The Learning & Development (L&D) team sits within the Center of Excellence Operational Excellence (CoE OPX) alongside the MPS and SAP Data & Processes teams. L&D drives business performance by designing, delivering and continuously improving targeted learning solutions, capability frameworks and development pathways that build skills, increase adoption and sustain operational excellence across the organization. In a fast-changing and highly regulated manufacturing environment, the role of L&D is essential in enabling transformation, supporting strategic priorities, and helping employees at all levels adapt to new ways of working.

Purpose of the role
Reporting to the Director of Operational Excellence, you play a key role in enabling performance and delivering results at our Boxmeer and De Bilt manufacturing sites. You will be responsible for shaping and ensuring the effective execution of the local learning strategy in alignment with strategic business priorities and our global L&D frameworks. You will lead and develop a team of 4 L&D professionals and act as a trusted partner to senior stakeholders, translating business needs into impactful learning and capability solutions that drive performance improvement, change adoption, and sustainable behavior change. You will work closely with Site Leaders, Global L&D, and external learning partners to ensure that L&D contributes directly to strategic objectives and workforce readiness.

Main tasks and responsibilities
·       Shape the learning and capability strategy for the site. Translate business and workforce needs into a clear learning strategy and execute solutions in partnership with business leaders, HRBPs, and site functions to ensure an integrated plan.
·       Serve as strategic learning business partner and advisor to Senior Leadership; position L&D as a lever for the Manufacturing the Future Strategy and broader business transformation.
·       Lead and manage a team of site L&D Specialists and -admins: set priorities, establish measurable outcomes, and oversee analysis, design, and execution of site learning needs.
·       Align site-level execution with Global Learning & Development (GL&D), localizing global initiatives and ensuring proper delivery of core and common curriculum.
·       Strengthen the skills and capabilities of the current and future workforce to ensure relevance, readiness, and on-time execution.
·       Run L&D like a business: drive efficiencies, align governance to business needs, and build L&D capability for higher impact.
·       Establish, deepen, and sustain relationships with site leadership, managers, and HR business partners to identify business needs, capability gaps, and priorities.
·       Lead cross-functional collaboration with stakeholders and subject-matter experts to define desired performance outcomes and design appropriate learning solutions.
·       Identify performance gaps and deliver or facilitate learning solutions; document customization and localization needs for global programs and develop local solutions when required.
·       Drive automation and digitalization within Learning & Development and training processes to streamline processes, improve learner experience, and enhance overall efficiency.
·       Own and administer the regional/site learning system (including QMS Training Subsystem standards); ensure compliance with GL&D, GMP, EHS, and other required standards.
·       Act as Business Process Owner for QMS GMP Training Standard (2.2) and serve as key contact for GMP audits and regulatory inspections.
·       Deliver training directly when needed and/or support local SMEs to develop and deliver training; manage site onboarding aligned with Manufacturing Division onboarding.
·       Act as liaison with Learning Support Services to align tools and administration with site needs; ensure solutions meet client requirements.
·       Stay current on L&D tools, techniques, strategies, and best practices; share leading practices with teams and stakeholders.
·       Monitor progress of strategic learning initiatives, remove barriers, and ensure timely delivery, adoption, and measurable impact.

Your profile
- Bachelor’s or master’s degree in a relevant field (e.g., Human Resource Management, Organizational Psychology, Business Administration, Engineering).
- Proven experience designing and executing Learning strategy.
- Strong experience with leading transformational change, stakeholder management, and navigating resistance to change.
- Strong ability to influence, build commitment, and manage competing priorities in a complex and evolving environment.
- Familiarity or affinity with regulated manufacturing environments and working within compliance frameworks.
- Proven ability to lead and mentor a small team of specialists, whether in a temporary project role or within a formal reporting structure.
- Drive for Continuous Improvement and a digital mindset with experience in automating and digitalizing (learning) processes.
- Fluent in English. Proficiency in Dutch is preferred, or a willingness to learn Dutch is highly valued.
- Ideally based within commuting distance of Boxmeer, or willing to relocate, as the role requires a strong on-site presence of at least four days per week.

What we offer
A high-impact role within a complex site of more than 2.500 colleagues, contributing to the company’s future by strengthening workforce capabilities through targeted continuous improvement and transformation programs. This is an opportunity to apply strategic planning, execution excellence, networking, and partnership skills to drive meaningful progress. You will have the chance to shape how our workforce learns, adapts, and performs in a changing environment. Our benefits are very competitive, and the summary below will give you an idea of what you can expect.
·       Competitive compensation aligned with your knowledge and experience.
·       3% year-end payment and an annual bonus based on individual and company performance.
·       35,5 days of leave.
·       Solid Pension Plan.
·       Travel allowance for commuting.
·       Numerous training, coaching and e-learning modules for long term job opportunities and development.
·       Excellent accessibility: the train station is right by our main entrance and there is ample parking.
·       High-quality company restaurant with fresh, healthy options daily.
·       Contribution toward your personal sports/fitness membership to support your vitality.
·       Beautiful private park on the premises, ideal for a walk, break, or moment of relaxation.
·       Mental well-being support via Lyra Health for you and your family members.
·       Access to a dedicated prayer/meditation room.

Animal Health
Our Animal Health Division is a trusted global leader in veterinary medicine, dedicated to preserving and improving health, well-being, and performance of animals and the people who care for them. We are a global team of professionals working together to make a positive difference in animal care and the world’s food supply and have a deep sense of responsibility towards our customers, consumers, animals, society, and our planet.
Through our commitment to The Science of Healthier Animals®, we offer veterinarians, farmers, pet owners and governments one of the widest ranges of veterinary pharmaceuticals, vaccines and health management solutions and services as well as an extensive suite of digitally connected identification, traceability and monitoring products. We invest in dynamic and comprehensive R&D resources and a modern, global supply chain. We are present in more than 50 countries, while our products are available in some 150 markets.

Applications can only be submitted through our career site.

Our US Ophthalmology team is dedicated to improving the lives of patients with diabetic macular edema (DME) and neovascular age-related macular degeneration (nAMD) through a pipeline of two investigational therapies. - Lead, recruit, onboard, train, develop, and retain a large and high-performing sales organization in a competitive sales environment, including district sales managers and customer team representatives.
- Drive insight gathering and stakeholder mapping activities, including appropriate disease state education before product approval
- Drive product launch readiness and commercial growth, partnering with cross-functional teams to optimize product positioning, omnichannel engagement, and field execution.
- Translate corporate and brand strategies into operational objectives, KPIs, and execution plans; track progress and refine plans to meet targets.
- Establish clear performance standards, set Sales Incentives Plans, conduct regular reviews, coach managers, and provide succession planning and professional development.
- Build an inclusive culture that values collaboration, accountability, patient-centricity, and ethical conduct.

- Engage key stakeholders in Retina market as the National Sales Leader
- Partner closely with Field Reimbursement and Account Management teams in line with compliance standards.
- Manage operating expense budgets, ensure compliant activity, and drive disciplined, fact-based decision making across the team.

Education:

jobs.title: Associate Director, Learning & Development - Oncology
jobs.description:
Job Description

The Associate Director in Global Learning & Development is responsible for serving as a trusted business advisor to business leaders and stakeholders in the Oncology Business Unit in order to enable business goals and outcomes by accelerating the development of critical capabilities needed to drive business success through a productive and engaged workforce. S/he maintains awareness and understanding of key business priorities/processes and external best practices, partners with key divisional stakeholders to identify performance needs and gaps, and collaborates with design experts and operational support points on desired performance outcomes. This leader will build and maintain strong business relationships, build sponsorship, and collaborate as part of an integrated learning network. Success in this role depends on a candidate’s ability to translate the goals of the business into learning strategies and solutions, then oversee effective design and delivery through a network of internal and at times external colleagues.

Responsibilities:
- Serve as the main point of contact for the Oncology Business Leaders
- Align business leaders on the implications of short and long-term decisions, strategies, and large-scale change efforts on employee learning and development in their respective business areas, and how those implications will affect sustainable business results
- Develop depth of business understanding to maximize relevance and impact on business outcomes
- Determine learning strategies and plans based on identified needs and gaps to achieve business strategy. Align business managers around “best fit” learning strategies while collaborating within GL&D and external partners to leverage existing and/or develop learning solutions to meet unique business requirements
- Prioritize and manage portfolio of work and overall Learner Experience at level of responsibility.  Ensure that plans are integrated and congruent with those of other areas of GL&D.
- Create line of sight for divisional clients into short-, mid-, and long-term L&D plans, existing resources and access to them. Build sponsorship for forthcoming L&D initiatives
- Provide critical input to the curriculum design and development team responsible for overall planning of learner experiences and solutions. Ensure these deliverables drive business relevance and impact and provide a modern, compelling learning experience.
- Collaborate with HR business partners in business area to integrate learning solutions with other talent-related initiatives,
- Deliver training and/or support local SMEs providing training, as needed
- Partner with the business to define business and learning outcomes.   Measure and report impact of learning programs against set metrics.  Use data insights to continuously improve solutions and outcomes.
- Ensure execution of a coherent, efficient, and strategically aligned approach to L&D planning and implementation.
- Deliver or facilitate training content.  Coach and build capability of local L&D colleagues or global/local subject matter experts who will deliver or facilitate, as needed
- Ensure accurate forecasts and project risk management

​ Competencies:
- Business Acumen: Ability to engage with mid-level business leaders around business strategy, goals, and business outcomes, and make sound business decisions
- Leadership: Intermediate ability to partner, collaborate, and impact decisions at all levels within and outside the organization.
- Collaboration: Work with individuals and groups in a constructive and collaborative manner, including the ability to build and maintain critical networks and collaborative relationships. Take full advantage of resident expertise in GL&D internal partner organizations (such as Design & Development and Learning Operations) to maximize efficiency and effectiveness; personally remain focused on key Learning Partner responsibilities.
- Creative Thinking: Intermediate skill in applying tools and techniques for grasping new concepts, acquiring new ways of seeing things, and revising ways of thinking and patterns of behavior
- Business Consulting: Expertise in consulting and ability to coach clients not to use learning solutions where they will not be effective
- Oral and Written Communications: Ability to express oneself to provide information to others effectively and in a succinct manner; outstanding verbal, written, and executive level presentation abilities and interpersonal skills; ability to ask thoughtful questions to gain insights, listen, and understand other perspectives
- Decision Making and Critical Thinking: Ability to use a broad range of methods, assumptions, frameworks, and perspectives when solving problems and making decisions.  Ability to ruthlessly prioritize own and (if applicable) team’s work.  Seek first to leverage existing resources and align with other areas of GL&D before developing new assets
- Data analytics: Ability to determine business and learning outcomes, metrics and measurement strategies.  Ability to analyze and interpret data for business and learning decisions
- Planning: Project planning and management experience, including the ability to contribute to operational (short term), tactical (1–2 years), and strategic (3-5 years) planning in support of the business plan
- L&D Policies, Standards, and Procedures: Knowledge of and ability to use industry and organization standards, procedures, and policies relevant to staff learning and development
- Adult Learning: Theory and Practice: Experience in applying concepts and practices of adult learning to meet the dynamic needs of the business
- Learning Needs Analysis: Experience in assessing competency gaps and identifying what people need to learn for successful individual and organizational performance

Qualifications

Required:
- Minimum of a Bachelor’s Degree, or currently in pursuit of degree completion, or equivalent relevant work experience.
- Minimum of 10 years of related experience.
- Combination of experience in facilitating / delivering learning solutions, sales and/or relevant pharmaceutical/oncology experience.

Preferred:
- Master's degree preferred
- Prior leadership experience preferred
- Hematology experience highly desireable
- Experience in the areas of learning, talent, HR, or comparable areas; experience in applicable technical/professional areas pertinent to the division/function served (e.g., R&D, manufacturing, sales/marketing, etc.)

MSJR

Required Skills:
Adult Learning Principles, Customized Training, Digital Learning, eLearning Development, Experiential Education, Instructional Design, Learning Analytics, Learning Design, Learning Management Systems (LMS), Learning Metrics, Learning Strategies, Learning Tools, Organizational Development (OD), People Leadership, Performance Metrics, Sales Training, Stakeholder Engagement, Strategic Thinking, Talent Development, Training Delivery, Training Documents, Training Evaluations, Training Needs Assessment, Training Porgrams

jobs.title: Sales Manager & Strategic Account Lead
jobs.description:
Job Description

The Sales Manager & Strategic Account Lead is a pivotal leadership role combining people leadership, commercial execution, strategic account management, and customer engagement.
This role is responsible for building and developing a high-performing field team and for strengthening engagement across general practice, hospitals, pharmacies, and other relevant healthcare stakeholders and partners.
In parallel, the role serves as a strategic lead for Primary Care business and partnerships, with responsibility for improving patient care pathways through high-level stakeholder engagement, developing innovative partnerships, and driving customer segmentation and targeting excellence to optimize commercial execution and customer engagement.
The successful candidate will combine strong commercial capabilities with an entrepreneurial mindset, a passion for developing people, and the ability to translate strategy and customer insights into impactful execution.

Key Responsibilities:

Sales Team Leadership

- Build, lead, coach, and inspire a high-performing field team to achieve commercial objectives across hospital, general practice, pharmacy channels, and strategic partnerships.
- Set clear priorities, performance expectations, and development goals to support individual and team success.
- Foster a culture of accountability, collaboration, continuous learning, innovation, and compliance.

Strategy Development and Cross-Functional Collaboration

- Partner closely with the Business Unit Lead, Marketing, and other cross-functional colleagues to shape commercial strategies and co-create solutions.
- Ensure that field execution and account management support overarching business and brand objectives.
- Act as a strategic bridge between field execution, Marketing, Market Access, Medical Affairs, Business Intelligence, Analytics, and other relevant functions.

Customer Segmentation & Targeting Excellence

- Lead the development, implementation, and continuous optimization of customer segmentation and targeting models.
- Ensure segmentation insights drive customer engagement strategies, account prioritization, resource allocation, omnichannel execution, and field force effectiveness.
- Translate customer, market, and behavioral data into actionable engagement frameworks.

Strategic Primary Care Engagement

- Strengthen engagement within Primary Care by building strategic relationships with key healthcare stakeholders and decision-makers.
- Identify opportunities to optimize and improve patient care pathways.
- Represent the organization in relevant healthcare forums and stakeholder engagements.

Partnership & Business Development

- Provide strategic direction and leadership in developing innovative commercial partnerships and new ways of engaging healthcare and non-traditional stakeholders.
- Identify and assess new opportunities and collaboration models that can improve customer engagement, patient pathways, and access to appropriate healthcare interventions.
- Support the development of scalable business cases and commercial models, including implementation coaching.

Primary Tasks:

Sales & People Management

- Build and develop a strong field organization.
- Coach and develop team members to enable both individual and team success.
- Analyze territory data, customer engagement metrics, and market dynamics to optimize resource allocation, targeting, and commercial performance.
- Continuously refine customer segmentation and targeting models to optimize call planning, account prioritization, and customer engagement.

Strategic Commercial Alignment

- Collaborate with Marketing and cross-functional partners to provide field-based insights that shape go-to-market strategies.
- Drive adoption of segmentation-driven and omnichannel engagement approaches across the field organization.
- Ensure field execution remains closely aligned with business priorities.

Strategic Account Management

- Identify, map, prioritize, and engage critical stakeholders influencing Primary Care and patient pathways.
- Build strategic relationships with relevant healthcare decision-makers at local and regional levels.
- Identify friction points and opportunities within patient pathways and collaborate on solutions to improve patient outcomes.

Business Development & Partnerships

- Further develop strategic approaches to partnerships across traditional and non-traditional healthcare stakeholders.
- Prioritize partnership opportunities based on market insights, customer needs, and business potential.
- Support implementation of partnership models and commercial initiatives.

Qualifications & Competencies:

Education

- Master’s or Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, Life Sciences, Public Health, or a related field.

Experience

- Strong experience from the pharmaceutical, healthcare, or another relevant commercial environment.
- Demonstrated ability to translate strategy into impactful execution.
- Previous people leadership or Sales Manager experience is preferred but not required.
- Experience in Key Account Management, strategic account management, commercial excellence, sales force effectiveness, customer engagement, or similar commercially focused roles is an advantage.
- Experience using customer segmentation, targeting, customer insights, and analytics to improve commercial execution is preferred.

Leadership & People Development

- A people-oriented leader who can inspire, coach, and develop others.
- Ability to lead through collaboration, influence, accountability, and a genuine desire to enable others to succeed.

Market Knowledge

- Strong understanding of the Danish healthcare environment and the interaction between Primary Care, pharmacies, scientific leaders, healthcare decision-makers, and other relevant stakeholders.

Commercial & Strategic Acumen

- Strong strategic and entrepreneurial mindset.

jobs.title: Strategic Partnerships Lead
jobs.description:
Job Description

At our company, we are committed to advancing science and delivering meaningful health solutions that improve lives. The Strategic Partnerships Lead will play a senior role in identifying, shaping and leading high-impact partnerships with health system stakeholders, institutional players and strategic accounts. This is an opportunity to build models of collaboration that create value for patients, the health system and our company, while strengthening our external relevance and ability to deliver sustainable outcomes.

Role Purpose

The role will define and lead the strategic partnerships agenda, translating health system priorities and business needs into structured opportunities for collaboration. The Strategic Partnerships Lead will be accountable for building a clear area plan, establishing governance and prioritization, and ensuring that partnership initiatives are designed, executed and measured with rigor.

Key Responsibilities

- Define and lead the strategic partnerships plan, including priorities, governance, metrics and performance tracking.
- Identify, assess and shape partnership opportunities with institutional stakeholders, ULSs, and other relevant health system players.
- Design and negotiate innovative partnership models that create shared value, support health system priorities and strengthen business and reputational impact.
- Build robust business cases, using market understanding, data, analytics and digital tools to support decision-making, prioritization and follow-up.
- Lead cross-functional partnership initiatives from concept to execution, ensuring alignment across Commercial, Medical, Access, Policy, Legal, Compliance, Finance and other relevant teams.
- Manage strategic account plans, leveraging opportunities, anticipating risks and ensuring disciplined execution against agreed objectives.
- Establish trusted relationships with senior external stakeholders, bringing credibility, influence and a clear enterprise mindset.
- Test, learn and scale practical solutions, ensuring agility while maintaining strong ethical standards and full compliance with company policies.

Scope and Interfaces

This is a senior, highly cross-functional role requiring strong orchestration across internal and external stakeholders. Externally, the Strategic Partnerships Lead will engage with institutional decision-makers, ULSs, and other relevant health system partners to identify areas of mutual interest and build sustainable collaboration models. Internally, the role will work closely with Access, Policy, Medical, Commercial, Business Units, Legal, Compliance, Finance, Digital/Data and leadership teams to ensure that opportunities are strategically relevant, operationally feasible, compliant and measurable.

The role will require leadership without direct authority, the ability to align different perspectives, and the discipline to move initiatives from strategy to execution. It will also require active use of tools, dashboards, data and GenAI-enabled approaches to support prioritization, tracking, insight generation and continuous improvement.

Qualifications and Profile

- Senior experience in the pharmaceutical, healthcare or related sector, with a strong track record in partnerships, business development, strategic account management or institutional collaboration.
- Strong strategic thinking, with the ability to read context, identify opportunities, build business cases and translate complex dynamics into actionable plans.
- Credibility and influence with senior internal and external stakeholders, including strong negotiation, communication and relationship-building skills.
- Proven ability to lead cross-functional initiatives, manage complex projects and deliver through others without relying on formal authority.
- Solid business acumen, including understanding of market dynamics, health system priorities, value drivers, risks and financial implications.
- Entrepreneurial and pragmatic mindset, with the ability to test, learn, adapt and scale solutions in a disciplined way.
- Comfort with data, analytics, digital tools and GenAI-enabled ways of working to support decision-making, follow-up and performance tracking.
- Strong ownership, accountability and execution discipline, with the ability to manage priorities and deliver measurable results.
- Commitment to ethical rigor, diversity and inclusion, and full compliance with company policies and applicable legal/regulatory requirements.
- Degree in Business, Life Sciences, Health Sciences, Economics, Public Health or a related field; advanced degree or equivalent senior experience is valued.

Job Description

Marketing Lead – Transform Growth, Shape Strategy, Build High-Performing Teams

Our Oncology team is dedicated to delivering breakthrough innovations that extend and improve the lives of cancer patients worldwide. Our team of forward-thinking individuals achieve this through an unwavering commitment to support accessibility to medicine, providing new therapeutic solutions, and collaborating with governments and payers to ensure that people who need medicines have access to them. Our focus is on innovation and launch execution excellence; we translate breakthrough science into innovative medicines that help people with cancer across the globe.

Why This Role?
This individual will have the opportunity to:
- Be part of a team to expand access to the largest and most significant oncology product in the world

- Be part of the our company TW/HK/Macau Cluster

- Work on end-to-end brand lifecycle management from new launches to LOE planning

- Lead and develop talented marketing professionals.

- Report directly to the Executive Director, Cluster BUD

We are seeking a commercially minded and inspirational marketing leader to drive business growth, shape market strategy, and develop a high-performing team.
This is a unique opportunity to lead a critical franchise, influence enterprise-wide decisions, and make a meaningful impact on patients, customers, and business results.

What You'll Do

Lead and inspire high-performing talent:  Coach, mentor, and develop a team of 3–5 marketers, fostering a culture of accountability, innovation, and continuous growth while building a best-in-class marketing organization.

Shape the strategic direction of the business:  Develop and execute local marketing strategies that align with business unit priorities and broader regional and global objectives, ensuring sustainable long-term growth.

Drive commercial success: Own franchise growth and P&L contribution targets, translating strategic ambitions into actionable, data-driven plans that deliver measurable business impact.

Champion executional excellence:  Oversee the end-to-end marketing lifecycle, including campaign strategy, launch planning, budget management, resource allocation, and performance optimization to maximize return on investment.

Influence across the organization:  Act as a trusted strategic partner across Medical, Sales, Market Access & External Affairs, Regulatory Affairs, Legal, and other key functions to ensure seamless execution and alignment around shared goals.

Build capabilities for the future: Strengthen marketing capabilities, processes, and governance to enhance agility, accelerate decision-making, and elevate analytical and commercial excellence across the organization.

Engage and influence senior leaders:  Present strategic recommendations, business cases, and performance updates to senior leadership, proactively identifying opportunities, managing risks, and driving informed decision-making.

Ensure integrity and compliance:  Champion the highest standards of compliance and governance, ensuring all marketing activities meet local regulatory requirements and company policies.

Turn insights into competitive advantage:  Leverage deep customer, market, and competitive insights to inform strategy, define meaningful KPIs, and continuously optimize brand and portfolio performance.

This role is ideal for a strategic yet hands-on leader who thrives on building teams, delivering commercial results, and turning market insights into competitive advantage.

WHAT YOU MUST HAVE

Qualifications
- Education: Bachelor’s degree in Life Sciences or a related field.

- Experience: 8+ years of pharmaceutical marketing experience, preferably in oncology; demonstrated experience leading product managers, managing high-value brands, and supporting products across different lifecycle stages.

- Commercial acumen: Proven track record of developing and executing strategies that deliver measurable commercial impact.

- Cross-functional influence: Strong experience collaborating with Medical Affairs, Sales, Market Access & External Affairs, Regulatory Affairs, Legal, and other key functions.

- Leadership and people management: Experience building, coaching, and developing high-performing teams, with strong performance management capability.

- Analytical skills: Strong comfort with data-driven decision-making, KPI setting, and performance analytics.

- Communication: Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English and Mandarin.

- Regulatory and compliance awareness: Strong understanding of local pharmaceutical regulations and industry codes of practice.

Key competencies and behaviors
- Strategic thinker with strong hands-on execution capability.

- Strong stakeholder management, influencing, and communication skills.

- Balanced focus on people and results, with the ability to drive performance through the team.

- Collaborative, team-first mindset with a strong sense of ownership.

- High integrity and strong commitment to compliance and governance.

Who we are
We are known as Merck & Co., Inc., Rahway, New Jersey, USA in the United States and Canada and MSD everywhere else. For more than a century, we have been bringing forward medicines and vaccines for many of the world's most challenging diseases. Today, our company continues to be at the forefront of research to deliver innovative health solutions and advance the prevention and treatment of diseases that threaten people and animals around the world.

What we look for
Imagine getting up in the morning for a job as important as helping to save and improve lives around the world. Here, you have that opportunity. You can put your empathy, creativity, digital mastery, or scientific genius to work in collaboration with a diverse group of colleagues who pursue and bring hope to countless people who are battling some of the most challenging diseases of our time. La personne retenue transformera les dynamiques complexes d’accès des patients, les parcours de remboursement, les événements du marché et les données probantes en contexte réel en prévisions exploitables et en perspectives stratégiques qui appuient la prise de décisions d’affaires.

Responsabilités
- Concevoir et améliorer continuellement des modèles et des outils de prévision propres au Canada afin de faciliter le rapprochement des résultats avec les exigences des modèles mondiaux.

- Permanent, full-time role with competitive remuneration and benefits
- Ideal Location to be based: QLD - South West, Maranoa, Balonne, Central Western
- Territories Covered: Western QLD, covering the South West, Maranoa, Balonne & Central West
- Career growth: Expand your expertise in a growing, successful industry
- Professional development: Gain valuable experience in a dynamic, evolving role
- Tools of Trade (TOT): Car, Laptop, iPad, Phone etc provided

Ready to embark on an incredible career journey with a global leader in animal health? We’re searching for an experienced and driven Territory Sales Manager to take charge of the Western QLD Region, championing the well-respected COOPERS Animal Health and ALLFLEX brands. This is your chance to be a vital member of a passionate and energetic team at the cutting edge of Australian agriculture.

What You Will Do

As a Territory Sales Manager, you’ll be at the forefront: profiling, promoting, and driving sales of our industry-leading Over-the-Counter (OTC) BioPharma and ID products for production animals. You’ll build lasting relationships with Primary Producers, rural distributors, veterinarians, and key agricultural influencers, ensuring our solutions reach those who need them most. You’ll also be the immediate contact for technical support and product training, energising the region through dynamic marketing and innovative events.
Responsibilities include, however not limited to:
- Craft and execute strategic business plans in conjunction with the Regional Sales Manager that power annual growth and maximise sales across your territory
- Segment and engage both distributor and end user populations with targeted tactics tailored to local needs
- Drive brand campaigns with passion - delivering impactful point-of-sale materials and executing marketing strategies that elevate our presence
- Train distributor teams and work directly with livestock producers, sharing your expertise and helping them succeed
- Scout out new product and market opportunities, feeding your curiosity and fuelling innovation
- Report on local market intelligence - your insights will help steer our strategic direction
- Forge powerful relationships with key opinion leaders, veterinary professionals, and rural influencers, amplifying our impact in the community

- Set clear regional and district-level performance expectations, milestones, and measures, and provide practical execution guidance to District Managers.
- Prepare, allocate, monitor, and optimize the annual sales activity budget, including field execution and approved direct-sales activities, to maximize impact and return on investment.

- Ensure sales plans, trade programs, discounts, promotions, and related expenditures follow approved governance, policies, and authorization requirements.

2. Sales Execution and Performance Management
- Lead regional execution of approved portfolio strategies, marketing programs, customer engagement plans, product launches, and lifecycle priorities across all districts.
- Direct the development and implementation of sales objectives, operating rhythms, policies, and procedures that support marketing and business objectives.
- Drive demand generation across relevant channels and customer segments through effective field execution and customer-centered engagement.
- Monitor national, district, channel, account, and product performance using relevant sales, market, customer, and sales force effectiveness indicators.
- Conduct structured regional business reviews with District Managers to evaluate results, diagnose performance gaps, share effective practices, and agree corrective actions with clear ownership and follow-up.

jobs.title: AI Customer Success Consultant
jobs.description:
Job Description

The Position
Join a global healthcare biopharma company and be part of a 130-year legacy of success backed by ethical integrity, forward momentum, and an inspiring mission to achieve new milestones in global healthcare. Drive innovation and execution excellence. Join the AI Innovation Studio, a hands-on team focused on discovering, shaping, and validating high-value AI opportunities across the enterprise — turning business challenges into AI-ready use cases, value cases, and practical solutions that help our organization move faster and make better decisions.

As an AI Customer Success Consultant, you will serve as a core analytical resource within the AI Innovation Studio, partnering closely with the AI Innovation Studio leads to evaluate, shape, and validate AI opportunities across the enterprise. In this role, you will analyze business processes, synthesize research findings, build value cases, and produce the structured assessments that inform Opportunity Assessments and downstream PoC planning.
This role is highly research- and analysis-oriented. You will contribute directly to stakeholder research, process and workflow analysis, competitive and technology landscape scanning, and ROI modeling — producing rigorous, evidence-based outputs that enable alignment between business, AI, and delivery teams. While you will most often operate in partnership with Studio leads, you will also take ownership of specific analytical workstreams or lower-complexity assessments as appropriate.

What will you do?
- Perform structured analysis of business processes, workflows, and pain points to identify and qualify AI opportunity areas across multiple business engagements.
- Gather, organize, and synthesize data from stakeholder interviews, operational metrics, industry benchmarks, and internal systems to build a fact base for each engagement.
- Conduct landscape scans of relevant AI technologies, vendor capabilities, and competitive applications to inform solution shaping.
- Analyze and synthesize findings from stakeholder interviews, journey maps, and user research into clear problem statements, use cases, and desired outcomes.
- Document current-state workflows, user needs, pain points, and non-functional considerations required for Opportunity Assessment.
- Produce clear, well-structured analytical artifacts that translate business ambiguity into actionable inputs for AI and delivery teams.
- Apply a strong understanding of AI, automation, data platforms, and cloud technologies to assess feasibility, complexity, and value potential of proposed AI solutions.
- Evaluate technical and data constraints by reviewing architecture documentation, data availability, and integration requirements alongside architects, data scientists, and engineers.
- Ensure proposed AI opportunities are grounded in technical reality and supported by evidence prior to handoff to delivery teams.
- Own the end-to-end value case for each assessed AI opportunity — from initial data discovery and analysis through building ROI models and business cases — providing the quantitative rigor needed to validate, prioritize, and advance initiatives into PoC.
- Define and document scope boundaries, assumptions, success metrics, and risk factors to support early PoC planning.
- Ensure analytical outputs are complete, coherent, and decision-ready, reducing friction during transition to delivery teams.
- Maintain traceability from business problem through value hypothesis to recommended path forward.
- Build strong working relationships with business and IT stakeholders through clear communication, analytical credibility, and follow-through.
- Prepare executive-ready briefings, scorecards, and summary reports that distill complex analytical findings into clear recommendations.
- Contribute to positive stakeholder experiences by maintaining rigor, transparency, and momentum throughout engagements.

Qualifications, Skills & Experience Required
- High school diploma or higher.
- Minimum of 3 years of experience in business analysis, strategy, technology consulting, customer success, or innovation-focused analytical roles.
- Experience evaluating technology-enabled initiatives, with exposure to AI, automation, or data platforms preferred.
- Track record of producing structured analytical deliverables (business cases, opportunity assessments, ROI models) in complex enterprise environments.
- Research design and analytical synthesis, including the ability to structure ambiguous problems into clear analytical frameworks.
- Strong quantitative and qualitative reasoning, with comfort building financial models, value cases, and data-driven recommendations.
- Ability to clearly document business challenges, desired outcomes, and supporting evidence for audiences.
- Solid understanding of technology value propositions, including AI/GenAI, data platforms, cloud services, and automation.
- Ability to critically assess technical feasibility and engage technical partners with informed, evidence-based questions.
- Familiarity with Agile and iterative delivery approaches.
- Highly detail-oriented and intellectually rigorous, with comfort operating across multiple concurrent analytical workstreams.
- Strong written and verbal communication skills and high emotional intelligence.
- Organized, dependable, and effective in ambiguous, fast-moving environments.

What we offer
- Exciting work in a great team, global projects, international environment.
- Opportunity to learn and grow professionally within the company globally.
- Hybrid working model, flexible role pattern (e.g., even 80% full-time is possible in justified cases).
- Pension and health insurance contributions.
- Internal reward system plus referral programme.
- 5 weeks annual leave, 5 sick days, 15 days of certified sick leave paid above statutory requirements annually, 40 paid hours annually for volunteering activities, 12 weeks of parental contribution.
- Cafeteria for tax free benefits according to your choice (meal vouchers, sport, culture, health, travel, etc.), Multisport Card.
- Vodafone, Raiffeisen Bank and Foodora discount programmes.
- Up-to-date laptop and iPhone.
- Parking in the garage, showers, refreshments, massage chairs, library, music corner.

In addition to delivering high-impact solutions, this leader plays a critical role in developing organizational capability, equipping HR and business teams with the mindset, tools, and skills needed to drive agility, scalability, and sustained performance.

Primary Accountabilities
- End-to-End Product Ownership: Serve as the product owner for existing suite of organizational development products, tools and resources, driving the full lifecycle from design through implementation, user adoption, and continuous, data-informed iteration.  Act as the single point of accountability for the operational effectiveness, scalability, and business value of designated OD frameworks.  Build scalable, self-service resources, templates, and playbooks that enable HR teams to apply OD practices consistently and effectively.
- Enterprise Capability Building: Lead enterprise-wide capability building by coaching, upskilling, and enabling HR Business Partners and business leaders to apply core OD methodologies, diagnostic thinking, and change management principles.  Empower HR teams to deliver consistent, high-quality OD support autonomously.
- Strategic Direction & COE Development: Contribute to the strategic priorities, operating model, and service offerings of the ET&OD CoE.  Align OD product roadmaps directly with overarching enterprise business objectives and talent strategies. Actively research, evaluate, and integrate external market trends, emerging practices, and evidence-based methodologies to evolve existing programs and tools.
- Hands-On Execution & Organizational Navigation: Balance high-level consulting with direct, hands-on execution; this is a "doing CoE" where you will manage a portfolio of high-impact, high-complexity enterprise initiatives, ensuring clear governance, prioritization, and execution discipline.  Hands on leadership to lead diagnostic sessions, draft organizational designs, and build implementation roadmaps in partnership with divisional HR / divisional leadership.   Actively navigate complex, matrixed organizational structures to align stakeholders both within and outside of HR, break through silos, unblock execution hurdles, and ensure initiatives are driven to successful completion.
- Change Integration & Partnership: Partner closely with Enterprise Change specialists to embed enterprise change methodologies and toolkits into all major transformation efforts.  Ensure organizational designs, operating models, and capability initiatives are paired with structured change strategies to secure long-term business adoption.

Qualifications
- Bachelor’s Degree in human resources, business, or a related field; advanced degree preferred.

- Proven track record of managing complex, large-scale organizational effectiveness, workforce, or transformation initiatives in complex, matrixed environments.

jobs.title: Franchise Head - Immuno-Oncology Marketing Director
jobs.description:
Job Description:
Cancer is one of the most significant global health challenges today, representing one of the world’s most urgent unmet medical needs.

Our goal is to translate breakthrough science into biomedical innovations to help people with cancer worldwide. For our Oncology division, helping people fight cancer is our passion, supporting accessibility to our cancer medicines is our commitment, and pursuing research in immuno-oncology is our focus to potentially bring new hope to people with cancer.

Our mission is to deliver breakthrough innovations that extend and improve the lives of people with cancer.

We are focused on advancing innovative molecules that harness the power of the immune system to fight cancer. We are making considerable investments in the field of immuno-oncology and we are committed to accelerating every aspect of development and commercialization in order to bring our innovative investigational medicines to patients around the world.

We also recognize that we have a role to play – in partnership with other key stakeholders – in helping to ensure our products are accessible and affordable to those in need. Through access to care, partnerships with the community and expansion of our capabilities, we want to help as many people with cancer as possible.

Job Summary

Reporting to the Business Unit Director, the Franchise Head is accountable for one of the our leading  IO (ImmunoOncology) franchises.

His/her main responsibilities are development and implementation of marketing plans to achieve sales, market share, and strategic objectives while remaining within approved expense budgets. He/She will manage and develop a team of brand managers.

Position is based in Rome. Regular travel required (mainly national but also international) for around 25% of time.

- Development, communication and execution of Oncology commercial strategy
- People management responsibilities for the Marketing team

Education/Experience/Language

- Minimum 10 years of experience in the pharmaceutical industry
- Experience in Oncology is highly preferred
- Experience in marketing with product launch execution is mandatory
- Experience in managing direct reports required
- Experience in coordinating cross functional team
- Demonstrated track record of performance excellence in meeting targets and objectives

As the primary veterinary technical expert for our company Animal Health poultry products and services in Malaysia, the incumbent will work closely with internal and external stakeholders to deliver technical guidance, drive product adoption, and communicate the economic and health benefits of disease prevention and control programs. The role focuses on improving poultry health outcomes, farm productivity, and food safety.

In addition to practical experience, the intern program includes developmental opportunities and exposure to Senior Finance leadership. At the end of the internship, interns are given the opportunity to present their summer experience to a panel of Finance professionals including but not limited to our Finance Senior Leaders.

jobs.description:
Job Description

Unsere Gebietsvertretungen stehen in persönlichem Kontakt mit unseren Kunden. Sie verstehen ihre Bedürfnisse und beraten sie, um so die jeweils optimalen Lösungen für ihre Anforderungen zur Verfügung zu stellen. Die enge Zusammenarbeit unserer Außendienstteams spielt eine entscheidende Rolle bei der Förderung unseres kundenorientierten Geschäftsmodells.

Die Position des Regional Sales Manager (North/West) Livestock Technology (m/f/d) verantwortet die Führung des Vertriebsteams für Technologien im Wiederkäuerbereich, um regionale Umsatzziele sowie organisatorische Zielsetzungen zu erreichen und das Technologie-Produktportfolio erfolgreich im Markt zu positionieren. Die Position beinhaltet die direkte Führung eines regionalen Vertriebsteams mit bis zu 10 „Technology Sales Representatives (m/f/d)“ und/oder „Customer Success Specialists (m/f/d)“.

Die Verantwortung umfasst die Region Nord/West (Schleswig-Holstein, Niedersachsen, Nordrhein-Westfalen, Hessen, Rheinland-Pfalz und das Saarland). Der Stelleninhaber muss in dieser Region, idealerweise zentral, wohnhaft sein oder bereit sein, dorthin umzuziehen.

Zu den Aufgaben dieser Position gehören insbesondere:

- Entwicklung und Umsetzung eines umfassenden regionalen Geschäftsplans zur Sicherstellung einer konsistenten Produkt- und Programmimplementierung sowie der Erreichung der Vertriebsziele.
- Integration wirksamer Lead-Generierungsstrategien in die regionalen Geschäftspläne, um die Geschäftsentwicklung im Einklang mit den finanziellen Zielsetzungen voranzutreiben.
- Sicherstellung eines professionellen Account Managements mit dem Ziel, die Erwartungen unserer Kunden zu übertreffen, einen hohen Net Promoter Score zu erzielen und eine hohe Kundenzufriedenheit sicherzustellen.
- Direkter Einfluss auf die Performance der Business Unit durch ausgeprägte Führungs- und Managementkompetenzen.
- Verantwortung für Talent Management, insbesondere Gewinnung, Bindung und Motivation von Mitarbeitenden im regionalen Vertriebsteam.Führung, Coaching und Weiterentwicklung des Vertriebsteams sowie Förderung einer leistungsstarken und kooperativen Teamkultur. Durchführung formeller und informeller Leistungsbeurteilungen sowie kontinuierliches Feedback und Anerkennung von Erfolgen. Konstruktiver Umgang mit Konfliktsituationen.
- Zielgerichtete und wirkungsvolle Kommunikation zur Sicherstellung einheitlicher Botschaften und klarer Führung innerhalb der Region.
- Eigenständige Entwicklung neuer Ideen und Ansätze zur Weiterentwicklung des Geschäfts. Problemlösung über die regionale Ebene hinaus.
- Enge Zusammenarbeit mit den anderen regionalen Teams sowie den Bereichen Technology Support und den BioPharma-Teams.
- Baut starke Netzwerke innerhalb der EURAM-Region auf und nutzt den Austausch mit internationalen Peers zur Förderung von Best Practices und kontinuierlicher Weiterentwicklung.
- Aufbau und Pflege nachhaltiger Beziehungen zu relevanten Vertriebspartnern und Distributoren zur Förderung des Produktportfolios.

Qualifikationen / Fähigkeiten

- 5 bis 8 Jahre nachweisbare Berufserfahrung in einer kundenorientierten Funktion, vorzugsweise im Bereich Customer Success, Vertrieb, Account Management oder vergleichbaren Aufgabenbereichen.
- Begeisterung für Landwirtschaft und Technologie sowie ein fundiertes Verständnis der Milchviehhaltung einschließlich Reproduktion, Tiergesundheit, Fütterung und Milchqualität.
- Bachelorabschluss in einem relevanten Fachgebiet oder vergleichbare Berufserfahrung.
- Ausgeprägte zwischenmenschliche und kommunikative Fähigkeiten sowie fließende Deutsch- und gute Englischkenntnisse.
- Technisches Verständnis sowie die Fähigkeit, komplexe Produkte und Systeme zu erfassen und zu vermitteln.
- Fundierte Kenntnisse im Bereich Tiergesundheits-Technologien oder vergleichbare technische, produktbezogene und marktbezogene Expertise; Erfahrung im Milchviehmarkt ist von Vorteil.
- Praktische Erfahrung in der Milchviehhaltung oder Erfahrung im Direktvertrieb an Landwirte ist wünschenswert.
- Ausgeprägte Marktanteilsorientierung und Fokus auf Potenziale und Wachstumsmöglichkeiten.
- Kenntnisse im Gebiets- und Geschäftsmanagement.
- Führungserfahrung sowie die Fähigkeit, leistungsstarke Teams aufzubauen und weiterzuentwickeln.
- Hervorragende schriftliche und mündliche Kommunikationsfähigkeiten, Präsentationsstärke sowie analytisches Denkvermögen.

Führungsverhalten

- Handelt ethisch und integer
- Erzielt Ergebnisse
- Fokussiert Kunden und Patienten
- Trifft schnelle und disziplinierte Entscheidungen
- Handelt mutig und offen
- Entwickelt Talente
- Fördert Zusammenarbeit

Professionelle Kompetenzen

- Kaufmännisches und finanzielles Verständnis
- Zusammenarbeit über Organisationsgrenzen hinweg
- Strategisches Denken
- Effektive Kommunikation
- Problemlösungskompetenz
- Projektmanagement

Zentrale funktionale Vertriebskompetenzen

- Kunden- und Marktverständnis
- Produktkenntnisse und Portfoliomanagement
- Account Management
- Kundeninteraktion und Kundenentwicklung
- Marktzugang
- Regulatorisches und Compliance-Wissen
- Lifecycle Management

Mindestanforderungen

- Sicherer Umgang mit Microsoft Office, insbesondere Word, Excel und PowerPoint.
- Gültiger Führerschein.
- Bereitschaft zu umfangreichen Reisetätigkeiten mit Übernachtungen (ca. 50 %).
- Wohnsitz in der Vertriebsregion oder Bereitschaft zum Umzug in die entsprechende Region.

Unser Geschäftsbereich Tiergesundheit ist ein vertrauenswürdiger, weltweit führender Anbieter in der Veterinärmedizin. Die Erhaltung und Verbesserung der Gesundheit, des Wohlbefindens und der Leistungsfähigkeit von Tieren und den Menschen, die diese pflegen, stehen dabei im Fokus. Wir sind ein globales Team unterschiedlicher Fachleute, das gemeinsam daran arbeitet, einen positiven Beitrag für die Tierhaltung und die weltweite Nahrungsmittelversorgung zu leisten. Wir haben ein tiefes Verantwortungsbewusstsein gegenüber unseren Kunden, Verbrauchern, Tieren, der Gesellschaft und unserem Planeten.

Als eines der bedeutendsten forschenden Pharmaunternehmen in der Veterinärmedizin bietet Tiergesundheit Tierärzten, Landwirten, Tierhaltern und Regierungen eines der größten Portfolios an Tierarzneimitteln, Impfstoffen, Gesundheitslösungen und Dienstleistungen im Bereich Gesundheitsmanagement sowie eine umfangreiche Palette von digital vernetzten Produkten zur Identifizierung, Rückverfolgbarkeit und Überwachung. Wir investieren in dynamische, umfangreiche Forschungs- und Entwicklungsaktivitäten und eine moderne, globale Lieferkette. Wir sind in mehr als 50 Ländern vertreten. Unsere Produkte sind in rund 150 Märkten erhältlich.
Wir sind stolz darauf, ein Unternehmen zu sein, das auf den Werten seiner vielfältigen, talentierten und engagierten Mitarbeiter aufbaut. Der schnellste Weg innovative Entwicklungen voranzutreiben ist, unterschiedliche Ideen in einer integrativen Umgebung zusammenzubringen. Wir bestärken unsere Kollegen darin, sachlich über ihre Vorstellungen zu diskutieren und Probleme gemeinsam anzupacken. Wir sehen uns als Arbeitgeber der Chancengleichheit und engagieren uns dafür, integrative, vielfältige Arbeitsplätze zu fördern.

Menschen mit Schwerbehinderung und ihnen Gleichgestellte werden bei gleicher Eignung bevorzugt eingestellt.

Hybrid working (minimum 2 days/week in the office)

The Opportunity

Join our Oncology Business Unit and take a leading role in shaping the future of our UK oncology business. In a scientifically complex and rapidly evolving field, this position offers the opportunity to lead long-term strategy, guide a talented team, and translate breakthrough science into meaningful outcomes for patients. You will be accountable for defining and executing the strategy for our oncology portfolio, with line management responsibility for up to five members of the marketing team.

Leadership and Organisational Impact

The Strategic Marketing Lead manages a team of talented professionals and is expected to demonstrate enterprise leadership and to influence beyond their immediate area of accountability. Success in the role requires the ability to:
- Create a clear direction and maintain focus in a fast-moving and ambiguous environment.
- Influence senior UK, regional and global stakeholders through credible analysis, sound judgement and a compelling strategic narrative.
- Constructively challenge established approaches and make timely, evidence-based decisions.
- Orchestrate matrix teams, clarify roles and hold partners accountable for shared outcomes.

jobs.description:
Job Description

Our US Immunology team is committed to transforming the lives of patients living with Inflammatory Bowel Disease (IBD). We aspire to achieve this through relentless commitment to patients, innovation, ensuring access to life-changing therapies, and collaborating with healthcare systems, governments, and payers to make treatments available to those who need them most. Our focus is on the patients, scientific rigor and flawless execution—bringing breakthrough therapies to patients who need them.

Thought Leader Marketing Liaison (TLML) (Associate Director) is a key member of the Immunology brand marketing organization reporting directly to the Director, Thought Leader Liaison Team Leader. This position is responsible for ensuring that advocacy development, platform and product positioning, speaker program preparation and management, and congress engagement are strategically aligned with brand objectives and executed in a compliant manner. This will help our Company create a strong and sustained presence across local, regional, and national IBD communities. Additionally, this role is critical to ensure that key scientific leader insights directly inform brand and go-to-market strategies.

Primary Responsibilities

Advocacy Development:
- Assist in identification and mapping of national and regional scientific leaders (SLs), clinical leaders, and emerging experts across the US IBD landscape.
- Develop and assess advocacy of key opinion leaders around the scientific messages, product positioning, and medical education content.

SL/KOL Engagement Execution:
- Execute engagements with SLs, including congress participation, site visits, and HQ-approved activities (e.g., advisory boards, customer strategy sessions).
- Gather actionable insights from SLs to inform marketing strategies and brand planning.
- Provide real-time insights from KOL’s on approved key business questions / topics.
- Execute engagement plans with key thought leaders throughout the US and support development of approved educational content based on KOL and faculty input.

Congress Participation and Engagement:
- Collaborate with marketing team to determine participation and level of support in key IBD conferences.
- Secure key engagement meetings and congress execution between HQ employees and KOLs

Speaker Bureau Development & Readiness:
- Help identify and manage a US IBD Speaker Bureau, including faculty identification, onboarding, and training as appropriate to approved content.
- Ensure speaker advocacy aligns to our scientific platform key messages and supports speaker readiness for educational speaker engagements including congress product theatres.

Cross-Functional Collaboration:
- Collaborate with field facing roles according to our Company Policy to ensure alignment on SL needs and account dynamics.

Compliance & Governance:
- Ensure strict adherence to compliance regulations, internal policies, and industry standards in all engagement activities.

- Bachelor’s degree required; advanced degree (MBA, MS, PharmD, or equivalent) preferred.
- Minimum 5-8 years in pharmaceutical sales, marketing, or field medical engagement or KOL management roles.

- At least 3 years of IBD experience strongly preferred with existing Key KOL networks in IBD

- Excellent communication, interpersonal, and organizational skills

- Ability to influence and collaborate across a matrixed environment without direct authority.
- Travel up to 60% (including weekends and evenings for congresses and advisory meetings).

jobs.title: Clinical Safety and Risk Management Principal Scientist
jobs.description:
Job Description

The CSRM Physician is a leader in pharmacovigilance and is responsible for the overall clinical risk management and safety surveillance of assigned marketed products.  As chairs of the Risk Management Safety Team (RMST), CSRM physicians lead the development and maintenance of risk management and pharmacovigilance plans.

Primary activities include, but are not limited to:
- Chair of the Risk Management and Safety Team (RMST) a subteam of the PDT, for assigned products.  This may include participation in internal and joint internal/external research project teams relevant to the further study of marketed compounds.
- The CSRM Physician works closely with cross-functional team members including those from clinical development, epidemiology, regulatory affairs, statistics, and manufacturing to manage safety topics under evaluation to ensure efforts are aligned to meet global pharmacovigilance and risk management strategies for assigned products.
- Duties include all aspects of safety data evaluation, including assessing safety from multiple sources, e.g., clinical trials, literature and post-approval use and ensuring completeness of safety information in company core data sheets (CCDS).
- Accountable for scientific strategy for safety related documents (e.g., CTD components, Risk Management Plans (RMP) and Periodic Safety Update Reports) and for ensuring that the safety sections of Company product circulars are medically and scientifically appropriate.
- Responsible for safety surveillance activities for assigned products such as aggregate data analysis and post approval safety signalling reviews, using medical judgment in review of aggregate data and individual cases. Collaborates with CSRM Associate in order to oversee all safety surveillance activities for assigned products.
- Responsible for risk management activities such as contributing to recommendations for pharmacovigilance actions, making recommendations for labelling, and developing the RMPs, pharmacovigilance strategies and risk minimization activities as warranted in collaboration with CSRM medical associate.
- Oversees the review and approval of product labelling files stored in the safety database and demonstrates a working knowledge of MedDRA
- The CSRM Physician prepares safety summaries and analyses of safety related data for regulatory documents, aggregate reports, and may supervise the activities of CSRM medical associates in the execution of safety data analysis and authoring of regulatory documents.
- Participates in the development, implementation and evaluation of standards, processes, metrics, and other department initiatives.

Education:
- Required: Medical Doctor (MD)
- Preferred: Medical specialty

Required Experience and Skills:
- Minimum of 2-3 years clinical experience (in a patient care setting) following post-graduate medical training or other relevant clinical experience
- Minimum 7 years of professional experience with both clinical and pharmaceutical industry experience required, of which a minimum of 4 years MUST include safety experience (e.g. PV or clinical) involving causality assessment, analysis of aggregate safety data and/or authoring of safety documents
- Demonstrated organizational leadership skills
- Excellent communication, and writing skills in English
- Demonstrated skills in managing programs, processes, and facilitating meetings
- Effective presentation skills and experience influencing and negotiating
- Problem solving, conflict resolution and critical thinking skills

jobs.title: Clinical Safety and Risk Management Associate Principal Scientist
jobs.description:
Job Description

The Clinical Safety and Risk Management Medical Associate Principal Scientist performs primary medical review of serious adverse experience (AE) reports and other AE reports of interest in order to monitor and describe the safety profile of assigned products.
Takes an active role in the oversight and development of pharmacovigilance and risk management plans (RMPs) of assigned products under the direction/guidance of the CSRM physician.
Assists the CSRM physician to prepare responses to inquiries from health professionals and regulatory agencies regarding adverse experiences reported for assigned products.
In collaboration with the CSRM physician, strategizes with the Risk Management Safety Team (RMST) recommending appropriate data to respond to queries and analyze data.

Primary activities include, but are not limited to:
- Applies clinical, pharmacological, and epidemiologic knowledge and information technology (IT) skills in order to manage the safety surveillance and risk management of assigned products in collaboration with the CSRM physician

- In collaboration with the CSRM physician, accountable for monitoring the overall safety profile of assigned products and for describing the safety profile to ensure external communications regarding the safety of these products are accurate

- Performs safety surveillance review of adverse experience reports for assigned products which includes reviewing individual AE reports, aggregate safety data, published literature, and information from external databases

- Works with CSRM physician to select and analyze the appropriate data from available IT systems in order to investigate safety issues

- Prepares responses to safety inquiries from health care professionals, regulatory agencies, subsidiary staff, and other internal customers

- Demonstrates a working knowledge of pharmacovigilance and risk management; may educate stakeholders outside of CSRM about risk management and the role of CSRM

- Prepares summaries and analyses of safety related data for regulatory documents such as Periodic Safety Update Reports (PSURs), Developmental Safety Update Reports (DSURs) and summaries in support of regulatory filings

- Core member of RMST; represents CSRM on cross-functional teams and committees as appropriate. Assists the RMST with the development, maintenance, and monitoring of RMPs and Risk Evaluation and Mitigation Strategies (REMS) for assigned products

- Participates in the development, implementation and evaluation of standards, processes, metrics, and other department initiatives.

Qualifications, Skills and Experience:
- At least two years of clinical experience in a patient care setting is required

- Minimum 5 years of professional experience with both clinical and pharmaceutical industry experience required, of which a minimum of 2 years MUST include safety experience (e.g. PV or clinical) involving causality assessment, analysis of aggregate safety data and/or authoring of safety documents.

- Experience in drug safety, pharmacovigilance and/or risk management

- Excellent writing and communication skills in English

- Demonstrated leadership skills in managing programs, processes, and facilitating meetings

- Effective presentation skills and experience influencing and negotiating

- Computer skills - use of database and basic MS Office suite applications

- Problem solving, conflict resolution and critical thinking skills

- Candidates without prior pharmaceutical industry experience are welcome to apply and may be considered for a more junior entry level.

Preferred Experience and Skills:
- Subject matter expertise in specific departmental programs, SOPS, and departmental initiatives.

Education:
- Medical Doctor (MD)

jobs.description:
Job Description

This role is designed to accelerate our Human Health transformation as we work to create an AI-enabled, agile, and integrated commercial model. The Transformation, Director will lead a team responsible for shaping a future where strategy and execution operate as a unified system, transformation is delivered at scale with speed, and new capabilities such as AI and automation redefine how work is done. In this team leader role, the individual will provide direction, coaching, and prioritization across a portfolio of strategic initiatives while ensuring strong execution, talent development, and enterprise impact. As market dynamics continue to evolve and digital, data, and AI reshape how commercial organizations create value, HH is accelerating its focus on Commercial Model Innovation. This work centers on designing, scaling, and realizing the capabilities, ways of working, and integrated solutions that will enable a more agile, responsive, and growth-oriented future.

Key Responsibilities:

- Lead and manage a team of Associate Directors, providing direction, prioritization, and coaching to drive high performance and consistent delivery across transformation initiatives
- Own a portfolio of transformation initiatives aligned to enterprise strategic priorities, ensuring end-to-end delivery from strategy through deployment and value realization
- Translate enterprise strategy into a coherent transformation roadmap, aligning initiatives to business outcomes and sequencing for maximum impact
- Oversee pilot design, execution, and scaling, ensuring insights are codified into repeatable playbooks for enterprise adoption
- Ensure effective deployment of capabilities across brands and business units, driving adoption, change integration, and measurable value realization
- Establish governance, tracking, and reporting to monitor progress, risks, and value delivery across the transformation portfolio
- Partner with senior leaders across Marketing, Review, Data, Market Access, and Global teams to align on priorities, resolve trade-offs, and enable execution
- Shape future-state operating models, including AI-enabled workflows, embedded compliance, and ecosystem-based delivery models
- Drive evolution of roles, ways of working, and organizational capabilities to support future-state transformation
- Act as a senior thought partner to executive stakeholders, framing decisions, risks, and trade-offs
- Champion agile ways of working, fostering a test-and-learn culture that accelerates delivery speed and improves outcomes
- Ensure integration across initiatives, avoiding fragmentation and driving a cohesive Strategy Realization approach.

Education Minimum Requirement:

- Bachelor’s Degree, required
- Master’s Degree, preferred

- Minimum of 10+ years of related Industry Experience
- Minimum 5+ years Transformation or Strategic Planning Experience
- Experience leading cross-functional teams and initiatives

- Demonstrable experience executing comprehensive transformational change plans across a broad group of stakeholders/functions (HQ, field, COEs, strategic partners, executive sponsors, etc.) to work collaboratively and achieve success

- Experience working with external vendors to execute on transformational projects

Our Technology Centers focus on creating a space where teams can come together to deliver business solutions that save and improve lives. These locations, in addition to the other sites, are essential to supporting our business and strategy.

Role Overview:
The Webcast Customer Support Technician provides customer-focused technical support for virtual and hybrid webcasts. The primary responsibility is to guide internal customers and Market Teams through webcast preparation, platform setup, readiness checks, live-event monitoring, troubleshooting, and post-event follow-up. When business needs, scheduling, location, and technician availability align, the role also provides in-person webcast production support. The technician helps deliver reliable, professional event experiences by communicating clearly, resolving issues promptly, following documented procedures, and escalating risks when appropriate.

- Troubleshoot incidents using documented procedures; communicate status and workarounds; escalate issues when additional expertise or vendor support is required.

- Coordinate the receipt, quality review, version control, and distribution of presentation decks and other event materials.

jobs.description:
Job Description

Are you looking for an opportunity to grow your career and contribute to a greater cause? Join our innovative team at one of the largest industrial pharma companies in the Netherlands.

At location Haarlem we have an exciting opportunity for a: Financial Analyst

Welcome in our team
Our COSI Human Health (HH) Finance team leverages sophisticated financial analysis, planning, accounting, reporting and performance evaluation techniques to propel medical innovation and enhance people's lives. As part of this role, you'll manage, review, report. Furthermore, you will analyze inventory, production, and product cost data and support monthly accounting close and management cycles for multiple branches across the world in the Cost of Sales & Inventory (COSI) matrix organization.
Our Support Functions deliver services and make recommendations about ways to enhance our workplace and the experience of working at our organization. The Support Functions include HR, Finance, Information Technology, Legal, Procurement, Administration, Facilities and Security.

Purpose of the role
This position is part of the COSI matrix organization, which performs end to end activities from actual occurrence of a financial result till consolidation level in HQ. As a Financial Analyst your main tasks will be maintaining, reviewing, reporting and analyzing inventory, production and product cost data and supporting the monthly accounting close and management cycles for multiple branches. For this role you will oversee and deliver end to end cost accounting, compliance, and finance support.

Tasks and responsibilities include but are not limited to
• Maintain and create product cost under US GAAP rules.
• Control, analyze, and report production results and variances.
• Review and ensure accurate data is reported for monthly product cost and inventory consolidation close.
• Analyze standard revision on a global level and ensure appropriate accounting is performed.
• Identify and work on initiatives to improve cost control and increase efficiency.
• Provide accurate and timely financial cost and inventory data to customers.
• Participate in special and ad hoc projects to support management analysis.

Your profile
• Bachelor's/Master's in finance/business/administration/economics.
• 2-3 years of relevant work experience in Finance, preferably in manufacturing/production, analytics or cost accounting.
• Experience with SAP production analysis and in preparing accounts in accordance with US GAAP.
• Improvement mindset.
•Fluency in written and spoken English.

What we Offer
Working at our organization means collaborating to improve health in an international environment alongside dedicated colleagues.
You will have every opportunity to develop yourself and show who you are. In addition, you can expect an attractive benefits package, including:

- Competitive salary

At our Company Manufacturing facility in Durham, North Carolina, we currently have a Specialist Business Consulting position available.

jobs.title: Technology Compliance Specialist / CSV
jobs.description:
Job Description

The Technology Compliance Specialist is responsible for ensuring that computerized systems, data management processes, and system development activities within the Digital/Data Management Office (DMO) and across the site comply with global regulatory, validation, cybersecurity, and data integrity requirements.
This role provides IT compliance and Computer Systems Validation (CSV) expertise to safeguard the Systems Development Lifecycle (SDLC), maintain inspection readiness, and support the continued manufacture and supply of high-quality pharmaceutical products.

Bring energy, knowledge, and innovation to carry out the following:
- Ensure compliance with Global SDLC/CSV, Data Integrity, and IT Security policies, procedures, and regulatory requirements.
- Execute and maintain compliance activities for computerized systems, including change controls, periodic reviews, access management, disaster recovery, incident and deviation investigations, CAPAs, audit support, cybersecurity controls, policy deployment, training, and system administration.
- Support compliance with applicable regulations and standards including Chapter 14 (Computer Systems), EU Annex 11, 21 CFR Part 11, MHRA GMP Data Integrity Guidance, and Sarbanes-Oxley (SOX) requirements.
- Coordinate and support regulatory audits and inspections, acting as a key liaison for auditor requests, documentation management, and inspection tracking activities.
- Serve as Subject Matter Expert (SME) for DMO-owned compliance and validation processes, providing guidance on validation strategy, system compliance, and risk management.
- Maintain continuous inspection readiness through periodic reviews, mock audits, compliance assessments, and proactive remediation of identified gaps.

Our company's Manufacturing Division, is a team of dedicated, energetic individuals who are committed to being the most trusted supplier of pharmaceuticals and health products worldwide. Our facilities, along with our external contractors, suppliers, and partners, comprise an interdependent global manufacturing network that’s committed to delivering compliant, reliable supply to customers and patients on time, every time, across the globe.

- Monitor supply plans through Exception Management to exceed customer service levels while maintaining inventory targets and adhering to planning parameters.
